raw.description:
Location: Canada – Remote

Department: Finance

Position: Oracle Cloud Developer

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei. Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We are dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission

Nuvei is looking for an Oracle Cloud Developer to join the UFS Reimagined program within the Finance organization. The program is delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and EPM across the Nuvei finance landscape in two waves, alongside a systems integrator and a number of specialist 3rd party partners for solutions implemented in parallel. This role sits on the Nuvei side of that program and builds, tests, and supports the Oracle technical objects the finance ecosystem runs on.

The person in this role is hands-on. They will review and build integrations in Oracle Integration Cloud, develop reports, extracts, and extensions, prepare test data and execute the technical test cycles, investigate defects alongside the systems integrator and the peripheral system teams, and produce the documentation and runbooks that the support model depends on. Where an object needs to be built, proven, and handed over, this person does it.

The role reports to the Director, Oracle Solutions, works day to day with the Oracle Cloud Technical Architect, and collaborates closely with functional business process leads, the systems integrator's technical team, Nuvei's information security and enterprise architecture teams, and the incoming application managed support partner. The role continues beyond go-live as part of the in-house technical capability retained within Nuvei.

This role will suit someone with five or more years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud technical experience who has been through at least one full implementation lifecycle, from requirements through cutover and hypercare, and who is comfortable owning technical objects in a program with fixed phase gates.

Responsibilities

The role covers four areas. The balance of work shifts across the program, moving from specification review and build, through the test cycles and cutover at each wave, into support, defect resolution, and documentation once the ecosystem is live.

Integration Build and Oracle Integration Cloud

  • Review interface specifications, payloads, APIs, file formats, mappings, transformations, validations, and orchestration steps produced by the systems integrator, and mark up what does not hold.
  • Configure or develop the approved Oracle Integration Cloud components, reusable routines, validation rules, error messages, and exception-handling logic assigned to Nuvei.
  • Work fluently with Oracle Fusion Cloud integration surfaces, including REST and SOAP web services, the ERP Integration Service, file-based data import, and business events.
  • Apply the agreed coding, naming, version control, security, logging, and deployment standards to every integration component, and correct anything that does not comply.
  • Support the Oracle Integration Cloud posting path from the business rules platform on Azure and Snowflake into the Oracle general ledger, including file-based data import and reconciliation evidence.
  • Confirm build estimates, technical dependencies, reusable components, and development sequencing with the architect before construction starts.

Reporting, Extensions, and Fusion Technical Build

  • Develop and support reporting and extract objects using BI Publisher and OTBI, including the reports and extracts that feed downstream systems and the finance close.
  • Build Fusion Cloud extensions and personalizations where a functional configuration cannot meet the requirement, and keep them upgrade-safe through the quarterly update cycle.
  • Configure and maintain the technical elements of Fusion security, including role design support, data access sets, and segregation of duties.
  • Write and maintain SQL and PL/SQL for data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting across the Oracle ecosystem.
  • Implement integration security correctly, including OAuth and certificate-based authentication, service accounts, key and wallet management, and credential handling.
  • Maintain the technical design documentation for every object built or amended, at a standard that survives handover to the support partner.

Testing, Deployment, and Defect Resolution

  • Prepare representative test data and scripts covering normal processing, negative paths, duplicate transactions, retries, recovery, security, volume, and reconciliation scenarios.
  • Execute unit, system integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and recovery testing across Oracle Fusion Cloud and each connected peripheral system.
  • Reconcile test results back to source and target records, evidence the agreed data-quality thresholds, and obtain acceptance from the relevant business data owners.
  • Investigate defects with the systems integrator and the source-system teams, implement fixes, complete retesting, and close issues only when the supporting evidence is complete.
  • Support production deployment and cutover, including load sequencing, smoke testing, initial monitoring, and the stabilization period that follows each wave.
  • Move configuration and technical objects between environments, including Functional Setup Manager exports, integration artefacts, reports, and security definitions.

Post Go-Live Support, Runbooks, and Knowledge Transition

  • Produce and maintain code documentation, deployment instructions, operating procedures, troubleshooting guidance, and support runbooks for every object in the retained ecosystem.
  • Take part in the knowledge transition from the systems integrator and support the onboarding of the application managed support partner.
  • Provide the in-house technical support that sits alongside the partner-delivered service, covering the integration and infrastructure scope retained by Nuvei.
  • Build and maintain the technical monitoring, alerting, error queues, and replay mechanisms that the proactive operations monitoring model relies on.
  • Be actively available through hypercare, month-end close, and year-end, when support demand and business impact are both at their highest.

Requirements

  • Five or more years of hands-on technical experience on Oracle Fusion Cloud applications, including at least one full implementation lifecycle through cutover and hypercare.
  • Strong, current, hands-on Oracle Integration Cloud development experience covering orchestrations, adapters, mappings, fault handling, and scheduling.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud web services and integration patterns, including REST and SOAP APIs, the ERP Integration Service, file-based data import, and business events.
  • Report development experience with BI Publisher and OTBI, including data model design and performance tuning of high-volume extracts.
  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL, together with scripting in Python, shell, or an equivalent language for data profiling, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Experience building Oracle Fusion Cloud extensions and personalizations that remain upgrade-safe across the quarterly update cycle.
  • Practical experience of integration security, including OAuth and certificate-based authentication, service accounts, and credential and wallet management.
  • Demonstrated testing discipline across unit, system integration, regression, negative-path, and recovery scenarios, with evidence retained to a standard that stands up to audit.
  • Able to write clear technical design documentation and support runbooks, and to review specifications produced by partner and vendor teams.
  • Comfortable working in a program environment with a systems integrator, multiple partners, and fixed phase gates.
  • Clear and direct communicator, able to work effectively with functional leads, business stakeholders, and technical counterparts in other organizations.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Assets

  • Experience across the Oracle Fusion Cloud financials footprint, particularly General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, and Projects.
  • Experience building Oracle Fusion Cloud data conversions using FBDI, HDL, and related load methods.
  • Experience with high-volume transactional integration in a payments, fintech, or financial services environment.
  • Exposure to Oracle EPM Cloud and its integration with Fusion ERP through Data Management or Data Integration.
  • Oracle certification in Integration Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure, or Fusion Financials.
  • Experience supporting a newly implemented ecosystem inside a managed support or AMS model, including hypercare and month-end close support.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps practice for cloud integration, including source control, automated deployment, and release governance.

Benefits

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they are empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can't wait to meet you.

• Competitive holiday allowance

• Group Insurance Benefits

• Flexible working model

• Employee Assistance Program

Working Language

English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.

This position offers an expected compensation range of [95,000$-105,000$] per year, in accordance with Ontario’s pay transparency requirements.

Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position

You’ll own the product strategy and roadmap for Teladoc Health’s service communications and orchestration layer: the capabilities that determine when, why, and how members receive the right message across their care journey.

This role sits at the intersection of product, marketing, clinical programs, data, engineering, and operations. You will lead the evolution from distributed communications systems toward a scalable, data-driven orchestration platform that can support service communications, clinical nudges, onboarding journeys, communication preferences, and future AI-driven engagement.

A major focus on the role will be shaping Teladoc Health’s next-generation communication automation and orchestration strategy, including evaluation and adoption of best-in-class platforms that enable this strategy. You’ll need enough product and technical fluency to separate narrow internal builds from true platform capabilities, influence vendor and architecture decisions, and ensure the chosen path supports both near-term delivery and long-term member engagement needs.

This role demands more than delivery management. You’ll need to connect communications infrastructure to measurable business outcomes: visit growth, repeat engagement, reduced member friction, improved care-program activation, and operational efficiency. You’ll operate with high autonomy, bring a strong point of view in ambiguous cross-functional environments, and move teams toward a coherent strategy even when ownership is distributed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own the member communications orchestration product strategy: define and drive the roadmap for member communications capabilities across service, clinical, and engagement use cases, with clear linkage to member experience and business outcomes.

  • Lead build-vs-buy and vendor strategy: evaluate orchestration/CDP platforms; shape POC scope; partner with procurement, marketing, data, and engineering to make informed platform decisions.

  • Advance the migration path from distributed communications infrastructure; help define the transition from distributed paths toward a more scalable orchestration model.

  • Own communication preferences and consent experience: drive the product roadmap for member-facing communication preferences, data integrations, campaign remapping, and end-to-end testing so members have clear, trustworthy control over how Teladoc communicates with them.

  • Enable data-driven and AI-powered engagement: partner with data, AI, clinical, and product teams to support personalized nudges, journey-based messaging, suppression logic, segmentation, and next-best-action capabilities.

  • Translate complex architecture into product direction: work deeply with engineering, data, marketing ops, and platform teams on Snowflake, CDP, content management, orchestration logic, APIs, and downstream delivery systems; make tradeoffs visible and actionable.

  • Build the measurement framework: define success metrics for communications capabilities, including delivery performance, member engagement, booking conversion, repeat visits, suppression accuracy, preference adoption, and operational efficiency.

  • Navigate complex stakeholders: operate as a credible senior product voice across marketing, DAI/data, engineering, clinical services, operations, legal/privacy, design, and executive leadership; synthesize competing priorities into a coherent product direction.

  • Raise the bar on member trust and experience quality: ensure communications are timely, relevant, clinically appropriate, consent-aware, and not just operationally convenient; protect the member experience in areas where metrics alone do not capture trust or frustration.

The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No

Qualifications Expected for Position

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with significant experience in consumer-facing, platform, engagement, lifecycle, growth, CRM, or marketing-technology domains.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect product roadmap decisions to business outcomes, including activation, conversion, retention, visit growth, operational efficiency, or revenue impact.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, integrating, configuring, or owning communications, lifecycle, CRM, marketing automation, journey orchestration, or customer engagement platforms such as Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Customer.io, or similar systems.

  • Strong technical fluency, including the ability to engage substantively with engineering and data teams on architecture tradeoffs, APIs, event triggers, data pipelines, segmentation, consent/preference logic, and implementation complexity.

  • Experience leading build-vs-buy decisions, vendor evaluations, POCs, platform migrations, or large cross-functional capability investments.

  • Strong product judgment in ambiguous environments: able to distinguish narrow feature delivery from durable platform capability, and able to sequence work across near-term releases and long-term architecture needs.

  • Deep comfort working across marketing, product, data, engineering, operations, legal/privacy, and executive stakeholders in a matrixed organization.

  • Strong analytical orientation, including comfort defining measurement frameworks, interpreting funnel or engagement data, and translating insights into product decisions.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to synthesize complex technical and organizational issues into a clear point of view for senior audiences.

  • Proven ability to influence without formal authority and drive alignment across teams with competing incentives.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, fintech, insurance, or another regulated consumer category where trust, consent, privacy, and operational accuracy are central to the product experience.

  • Experience with CDP strategy, Snowflake-based segmentation, reverse ETL, data activation, or customer data infrastructure.

  • Experience with service communications, transactional communications, clinical engagement, care-management outreach, or member/patient engagement.

  • Experience working with engineering to build and maintain homegrown communication orchestration platform.

  • Experience building or integrating communication preference centers, consent systems, suppression logic, or notification-governance frameworks.

  • Empathy for members navigating health concerns and conviction that better communication can materially improve access, outcomes, and trust.

The base salary range for this position is $180,000 - $220,000. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

We follow a Flexible Vacation Policy, intended for rest, relaxation, and personal time. All time off must be approved by your manager prior to use. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. If you are applying for a part-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details.

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Teladoc Health will not sponsor or transfer employment work visas for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Why join Teladoc Health?

  • Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.

  • Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

  • Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.

Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. raw.description:
About Huckleberry

At Huckleberry, our purpose is simple yet powerful: to build life-changing products and experiences that help all families unlock everyday magic.
Today, more than 6.5 million families trust Huckleberry and our app to be their partner through parenthood. Real pediatric expertise works hand-in-hand with data science, AI, and behavioral science to provide support behind-the-scenes that guides every parent through their unique journey.
We believe every family should feel taken care of—which is why we’re growing quickly and expanding our product offerings to help every family thrive.

Design at Huckleberry

Huckleberry sits at the intersection of expertise and empathy. Our products need to feel credible enough to trust and approachable enough to use when parents are tired, busy, and looking for clear guidance.

Our brand is still early, which means there's a lot of room to shape where it goes next. We're beginning a brand refresh and redesigning our website, and we're looking for a designer who wants to help define the visual language.

About the Role

As Senior Brand Designer, you'll help define and evolve Huckleberry's visual identity and bring it to life across the business.

You'll work closely with the Creative Director and collaborate with partners across Marketing, Product, and Engineering to build a brand system that is distinctive, flexible, and useful in practice. Your work will show up everywhere from our website and campaigns to the App Store, paid media, lifecycle marketing, and the product itself.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You'll contribute to the big-picture direction while also doing the work to make that direction real, from developing the brand system in Figma to designing individual campaigns and experiences.

Areas of Responsibility

    • Partner with Product, Marketing, and Engineering to create a cohesive Huckleberry brand experience across the app, App Store, huckleberry.com, campaigns, paid media, lifecycle, content, and other brand touchpoints.

    • Help maintain and expand a flexible brand system that scales with the needs of the business.

    • Collaborate with the Creative Director to define how Huckleberry's visual identity is expressed across experiences and channels.

    • Act as a champion for the brand, helping establish a consistent and distinctive point of view across the organization.

    • Partner with Product Design to bring the brand into the product experience, not just the marketing around it.

    • Brief and collaborate with external partners across illustration, motion, video, and agency engagements to execute high-quality work.

    • Design through iteration, experimentation, audience insights, and performance data to understand what resonates with families.

    • Ensure consistency across marketing channels while identifying opportunities to evolve and expand the capabilities of our visual system.

    • Be an active participant in design at Huckleberry, providing thoughtful feedback across Marketing, Product, and Design teams.

Requirements

    • Minimum of 8 years of experience in visual design, in-house or in an agency setting.

    • Strong understanding of the formal elements of graphic design, including typography, color, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy.

    • A creative focus on visual design applied across surfaces such as web, mobile product, digital campaigns, video, and print.

    • A passion for branding, demonstrated through a portfolio of strong work across a variety of contexts, with a focus on brand systems.

    • Experience working with motion designers to conceptualize and build motion as part of a broader brand system. Individual motion experience is a plus.

    • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with designers and non-designers alike.

    • A curiosity to stay current with evolving design tools and techniques, balanced with a desire to develop an original, opinionated visual point of view.

    • A track record of collaborating with design, marketing, and business partners to translate project needs, audience insights, and constraints into thoughtful design decisions.

    • An ability to balance multiple projects, independently prioritize work based on project objectives and business goals, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

    • A proactive, self-directed work style and the ability to operate independently on a small team.

    • Thoughtful, collaborative, and high-quality in your approach to the work.

Huckleberry Labs is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

ABOUT NORIMA

We are Norima, a North American technology consulting firm with over 20 years of experience, helping businesses engage, understand, serve, and manage their clients through technology. Our team of hundreds of consultants delivers the optimal blend of practical experience, innovative technology talent, and subject matter expertise to their consulting engagements. We are selective about whom we bring onto our high-calibre team, hiring only those who embody and embrace our 3C value system: CHARACTER, COMPETENCE, CONSISTENCY.

Norima Consulting is expanding our Guidewire practice in India — and we're looking for sharp, passionate talent to grow with us. If you live and breathe Guidewire, we'd love to talk. We're hiring across the full stack of the practice.

Why Norima: You'll work on meaningful Guidewire programs with global clients, alongside a team that values craft, ownership, and genuine collaboration. No politics. No bureaucracy. Just good people doing great work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Guidewire Developer to deliver configuration, integration, and development work across insurance transformation engagements. You will work directly within client environments to implement, extend, and optimise Guidewire's suite of products — helping insurers modernise their core policy, billing, and claims operations.

Guidewire certifications are a strong differentiator for this role and are actively highlighted in how we position our team to clients. Certified developers bring demonstrated platform credibility that accelerates trust, reduces ramp-up time, and strengthens the quality of our delivery. If you hold one or more Guidewire certifications, we want to know about them — and we will make sure clients do too.

DETAILS

  • Employment Type: Full-Time Employment
  • Experience: Overall minimum 6+ years’ experience with 3+ Years of Guidewire Development or Implementation Experience
  • Mode of Work: Remote

GUIDEWIRE CERTIFICATIONS — WHY THEY MATTER HERE

We actively promote the certified expertise of our team members to clients and in proposal responses. Holding a Guidewire certification signals a verified, standardized level of platform knowledge that our clients rely on when selecting an implementation partner. Candidates who hold current certifications will be given preferred consideration and will have their credentials highlighted in client-facing engagements.

Certifications of particular value include:

  • Guidewire Certified ACE — PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, Cloud Integration
  • Guidewire Certified Associate — PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter
  • Guidewire Certified Professional — PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter
  • Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP) Certification
  • Guidewire Integration Certification
  • Guidewire Digital Portals Certification

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, configure, and develop solutions within Guidewire PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and/or BillingCenter
  • Build and maintain integrations between Guidewire and third-party systems including billing providers, document management, reinsurance platforms, and external data services
  • Develop and extend Guidewire using Gosu scripting, configuration, and product model customization
  • Support Guidewire Cloud Platform deployments including environment management, pipeline configuration, and cloud-specific architecture considerations
  • Collaborate with business analysts and solution architects to translate requirements into Guidewire configurations and custom development
  • Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and technical documentation in line with Guidewire best practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve defects across configuration, integration, and data layers
  • Support data migration activities including mapping, validation, and transformation logic
  • Contribute to upgrade and patch activities, assessing impact and managing regression risk
  • Work alongside client technical teams to enable knowledge transfer and build internal capability

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Overall 6+ years of experience with 3+ years of hands-on Guidewire development or implementation experience
  • Proficiency in Gosu scripting and Guidewire configuration and product model development
  • Experience with at least one of: PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter in a live implementation or upgrade
  • Familiarity with integration patterns including REST, SOAP, XML, and JSON
  • Ability to read and contribute to technical design documentation and solution architecture
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in client-facing delivery teams

Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that's fast-paced and ego-free, where innovation and collaboration are encouraged at every turn. We are an organization that provides federal agencies instant access to experienced and talented professionals who understand their unique challenges and know the most efficient ways to address them. We are continually investing in resources and talent, so we stay prepared with specialized teams in place who are experts in creating tailored technologies. Our solutions empower Federal organizations to grow, modernize, and succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape.

We value all voices and want to attract talent from all backgrounds. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Databricks Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data and analytics solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform in support of federal mission needs. The ideal candidate will have strong practical experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog, along with a solid understanding of modern data architecture patterns such as the medallion architecture and structured streaming. This role involves developing and optimizing data pipelines, implementing data governance and security controls, enabling advanced analytics and machine learning, and collaborating with cross-functional teams within a compliance-driven federal environment. By joining our organization, you'll help modernize how federal agencies use data to make better decisions and deliver better outcomes for the people they serve!

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, and Spark SQL.
  • Build and manage Delta Lake tables using the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture to deliver reliable, analytics-ready data.
  • Develop real-time and near-real-time data ingestion solutions using Spark Structured Streaming and messaging platforms such as Kafka.
  • Configure and manage Databricks clusters, jobs, and workflows in production environments.
  • Implement data governance, access controls, and security best practices using Unity Catalog.
  • Integrate data from a variety of source systems and destinations, supporting ETL/ELT and pipeline orchestration activities.
  • Optimize existing data workflows and Spark jobs for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Integrate Databricks development with CI/CD pipelines and enterprise SDLC tooling, including Git-based version control.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to define data models and support machine learning and AI use cases, including model lifecycle management with MLflow.
  • Support advanced analytics use cases such as anomaly detection, risk scoring, and fraud analytics.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data processing jobs, implementing data quality checks and observability to ensure high availability.
  • Document data processes, frameworks, pipelines, and data mappings for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Work closely with scrum teams, product owners, and client stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data solutions.
  • Stay current on Databricks platform capabilities and industry trends to recommend best-fit tools and technologies.

TAG:

TAG: INDMJC

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 4+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or big data development.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with the Databricks platform.
  • Proficiency in Apache Spark, PySpark, and Spark SQL.
  • Experience with Databricks clusters, jobs/workflows, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog in production environments.
  • Experience with medallion architecture and Spark Structured Streaming.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills for data engineering and data analysis.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline orchestration.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and their native data services.
  • Experience integrating data solutions with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based version control workflows.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, and access control best practices.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust determination.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ﻿Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional) or cloud platform certification.
  • Experience implementing ML or AI solutions in Databricks, including MLflow-based model lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of machine learning, AI, or Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, including text mining.
  • Experience supporting fraud analytics, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
  • Experience with distributed data and streaming tools such as Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, or Amazon EMR.
  • Experience with data quality frameworks and observability/monitoring tooling.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with visualization packages such as Plotly, Seaborn, or ggplot2.
  • Experience supporting federal government or regulated-industry programs, especially the Department of Veterans Affairs.

  • Participate in Workday community forums, brainstorms, and product feedback channels, contributing field perspective and bringing back valuable insights and emerging best practices to the broader team.

The Tier 2 Technical Support Analyst serves as a key technical leader responsible for resolving complex, high-priority escalations and maintaining business-critical IT operations nationwide. Operating with high autonomy, this role drives technical decision-making across advanced infrastructure, network systems, telephony, and specialized clinical hardware.

By combining advanced troubleshooting expertise with continuous process improvement, chatbot workflow engineering, and Tier 1 mentorship, the Specialist ensures seamless service continuity, elevates organizational IT capabilities, and mitigates operational risk across healthcare environments.

Primary Job Duties

  • Tier 2 Escalation & Remote User Support: Resolve complex, high-priority Tier 2 technical escalations and conduct advanced remote diagnostic sessions to ensure operational continuity for end users.

  • Network Infrastructure & Troubleshooting: Perform complex network troubleshooting and infrastructure setup, managing Meraki firewalls, switches, access points, VPNs, VLANs, and DNS configurations.

  • Hardware & Medical Device Support: Oversee specialized hardware deployments, integrations, and diagnostics, including critical clinical equipment (EKG, ECG, Spirometry) and point-of-sale systems.

  • Endpoint Management & Imaging: Manage endpoint lifecycle operations via NinjaOne, directing system onboarding, offboarding, baseline imaging, and software deployment security controls.

  • IT Procurement & Vendor Coordination: Coordinate IT procurement and manage external technical field contractors to ensure seamless physical and operational dispatch execution.

  • Google Workspace Administration: Manage Google Workspace administration, governing directory structures, group permissions, and enterprise access security controls.

  • 8x8 Telephony Administration: Administer enterprise 8x8 telephony infrastructure, executing critical modifications to call queues, access permissions, call routing, and auto-attendant scripts.

  • AI Initiatives & Chatbot Support: Drive organizational AI integration by engineering, maintaining, and optimizing automated chatbot workflows (e.g., Cognigy) to streamline operational support.

  • Tier 1 Support, Training & Upskilling: Provide critical overflow support while delivering technical mentorship and training to Tier 1 teams to elevate service desk capabilities and resolution efficiency.

  • Operational & Go-Live Support: Provide real-time technical leadership and incident resolution during care center go-lives and cross-functional IT operations.

  • Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Develop standard operating procedures, technical playbooks, and knowledge base assets to drive systematic operational improvements.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Bachelor's degree or commensurate experience preferred.

  • 2+ years of work-related experience in IT desktop support, network administration, or technical operations (healthcare environment experience preferred).

  • Strong technical background supporting Google Workspace, Ninja One (or equivalent RMM/imaging platforms), ConnectWise, and Salesforce.

Our solutions empower Federal organizations to grow, modernize, and succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape.

We value all voices and want to attract talent from all backgrounds. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Databricks Apps Developer to design and build interactive, user-facing data and AI applications on the Databricks platform. This role focuses on front-end development and user-centric workflow design, using Databricks Apps to turn trusted lakehouse data, analytics, and AI models into intuitive applications that users rely on to make decisions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and REST API integration, along with hands-on experience connecting applications to Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, Delta tables, Databricks SQL, AI/BI dashboards, Genie, and Model Serving. This role involves collaborating with data engineers, data scientists, and stakeholders to rapidly prototype, iterate, and deliver production-ready applications that go beyond standalone dashboards. By joining our organization, you'll help federal agencies put their data and AI to work in the hands of the people who need it!

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy interactive data and AI applications using Databricks Apps.
  • Build React-based user interfaces and reusable front-end components using TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Integrate applications with Databricks capabilities, including Unity Catalog, Delta tables, Databricks SQL, AI/BI dashboards, Genie, MLflow, and Databricks REST APIs.
  • Integrate AI and LLM features through secure APIs and Databricks Model Serving endpoints to enable prompt-driven and context-enriched user workflows.
  • Develop lightweight back-end services and APIs using Python (e.g., FastAPI, Flask) or Node.js to connect front-end features to underlying data and models.
  • Enable user-driven filters, inputs, and scenario ("what-if") analysis, with clear explanations of assumptions and recommendation rationale.
  • Partner with data engineers and data scientists to connect application features to Delta Live Tables, Jobs, Workflows, and analytical models.
  • Implement application authentication, authorization, and data access controls in alignment with Unity Catalog governance and federal security requirements.
  • Translate stakeholder goals into user stories and acceptance criteria to guide application feature development.
  • Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions, incorporating user feedback to refine UX and functionality.
  • Develop reusable UI components, templates, and deployment patterns to accelerate future application builds.
  • Use Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines to manage application code and deployments.
  • Document front-end architecture, design patterns, and application configurations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Stay current on Databricks Apps and platform capabilities to recommend best-fit solutions.

  • Experience integrating front-end applications with REST APIs, serverless endpoints, or cloud-hosted microservices.

About the role

As a Lead Medical Writer, you will take ownership of delivering high-quality, scientifically accurate content across a range of Oncology focused medical communications projects (congress activities, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, plain language summaries) transforming complex data into clear, engaging stories for healthcare professionals. You will lead multiple accounts, ensuring editorial excellence from initial planning through to final review. You will guide and support writers, manage content allocation, and play an active role in strategic client interactions. You will benefit from a clear, structured career pathway, with the opportunity to progress to Associate Scientific Director and beyond as you continue to expand your scientific, strategic and leadership skills. Your expertise will be key to maintaining high quality standards and driving successful outcomes for our clients.

What you'll do

  • Act as a lead writer and client contact for assigned accounts
  • Develop content, working closely with your assigned project team to ensure quality editorial implementation of all assigned-client programs
  • Effectively and proactively communicate with the editorial, client, vendor and project teams to ensure projects are completed on time and budget
  • Briefing, reviewing, guidance and direction to less experienced writers in account team​
  • Provide high‑quality scientific oversight for assigned large/complex projects or a workstream
  • Drive project delivery and champions processes both internal and external (including compliance)​
  • Provide business development support, investigate, conceptualise, and strategize new medical communications projects and publications to support the assigned-clients needs and opportunities
  • Represent Avalere Health at client meetings, advisory boards, speaker-training meetings, business development initiatives

About you

  • Degree in the life sciences; PharmD or PhD advantageous
  • Ideally 3 years+ experience in medical or scientific writing within a healthcare consultancy or medical communications agency
  • Proven experience in the development of scientific content across a varied range of therapeutic areas, Oncology expertise is advantageous but not essential
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a variety of scientific content types, including publications, and review content for accuracy and flow
  • Proven experience in project ownership and problem-solving, with the ability to work proactively in a collaborative team environment
  • Strong client communication skills and the ability to serve as a reliable point of contact for clients and external experts
  • Ability to provide leadership and mentoring to junior writers
  • Experience managing client relationships and serving as a key point of contact
  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory guidelines for medical communications

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

  • Certifications
    • Certified Government Meeting Professional (CGMP), Certified Meeting Professional (CMP), or equivalent certification in event management/hospitality.
  • Skills & Competencies
    • Strong organizational, budgeting, and vendor management skills.
    • Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings/weekends, with worldwide travel.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Ability to maintain compliance with security, childcare, and safety requirements.

Professional Standards

  • Maintain a professional appearance and conduct in alignment with Army standards.
  • Ensure contractor status is clearly identified when interacting with government personnel.

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the myasthenia gravis (MG) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Myasthenia Gravis News.

Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities.

All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position.

  • Experience in being professionally edited for publication.

  • Experience with the Slack communication app.

Abilities Required

Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information.

To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community.

## About Vetto

Vetto is a global platform that connects top-tier professionals to strategic Artificial Intelligence projects around the world. Our mission is to build trust, quality, and long-term value within the AI ecosystem, for both exceptional talent and companies operating at the forefront of technology.

## About the project

We are opening a freelance opportunity for the Safety Project — Emotional Distress (Clinical track), a project focused on evaluating how AI systems respond in sensitive conversations involving emotional distress, suicidal ideation, and depression. The goal of this project is to assess whether the AI can respond with empathy, responsibility, and appropriate safety awareness in high-risk emotional scenarios.

In this track, selected contributors will perform two complementary activities:

1. Role-play— participate in structured multi-turn conversations with an AI system, acting according to a predefined persona and scenario representative of real clinical presentations. 2. Evaluation — review AI responses against clinical criteria, assessing risk recognition, appropriateness of safety messaging, empathy, accuracy of psychoeducation, and adherence to evidence-based crisis-response practices.

This dual contribution is what makes the clinical track distinct: we need professionals who can both embodya sensitive scenario and judge the AI's response with clinical rigor.

## What you'll do

  • Conduct role-play sessionsas a clinically informed persona across multi-turn conversations - Evaluate AI responses for safety, empathy, clinical appropriateness, and risk handling - Provide structured written feedback grounded in clinical reasoning - Flag responses that miss risk signals, give unsafe guidance, or fall short of best-practice crisis communication

## Who can apply

Licensed or formally trained professionals in psychiatry, clinical psychology, counseling psychology, psychiatric nursing, or related mental health fields— including those working in crisis centers, helplines, or other mental health support environments. Experience in suicide prevention, crisis intervention, or risk assessment is highly valued.

## Profiles we're looking for

  • Psychiatry or psychiatric nursing - Clinical or counseling psychology - Crisis intervention or suicide prevention specialists - Social work focused on mental health - Helpline or support center professionals (clinical role) - Emotional health coaching or therapy with formal training - Researchers or educators in mental health and risk assessment

Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

Summary

In this role, you’ll own the technical and functional win across a high-volume SMB sales motion. You’ll partner closely with a team of account executives, along with Product and Professional Services, to support fast-moving, transactional sales cycles across multiple product lines.

Success in this role requires someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is comfortable delivering frequent, repeatable product demonstrations while maintaining a high standard of quality and customer engagement. Beyond supporting active opportunities, you’ll help strengthen a growing sales team by providing ongoing enablement, refining repeatable processes, and identifying ways to make the sales motion more efficient and scalable. This may include expanding the use of external demo-library tools, leveraging AI to develop new workflows, and finding creative ways to automate or streamline repetitive work.

How will you contribute?

  • Spend 50-70% of your time working on revenue generating deals, with the remaining time spent on supporting our internal projects, ongoing learning, and supporting cross-departmental initiatives as needed.
  • Assist sales with discovery process to identify quantifiable problems our solutions can solve
  • Demonstrate/Workshop/Solution how our products/platform can help our prospects/customers achieve their desired business outcomes and realize value
  • Lead the scoping and execution of validation events where appropriate

  • Present professional services and success management offerings as part of a comprehensive solution

What will you bring?

  • An ability to demonstrate our products in a way to sells the value of our solutions aligned to a client’s business objectives and pain points

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. raw.excerpt: OverviewExperian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions.
raw.description:
Overview

Experian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms.

We're looking for a motivated Data Scientist to help build fraud detection models and features that identify high-risk activity while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Core skills for this role include an eagerness to collaborate, and empathy. You will will dig into surprising signals in the data and to learn how that insight becomes a deployed model.

You will help investigate the latest fraud patterns, build features, and train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with senior data scientists and engineers starting with problem definition through feature engineering, experimentation, and deployment. You will be a developing programmer, ready to translate theoretical principles into production-ready solutions.

We continue to sharpen through research and the engineering that turns those findings into tools and systems built for commercialization.

This is a remote role and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics.

What you'll do

  • Investigate large datasets, including exploratory analysis and fraud label development, to identify latest fraud patterns, attack methods, and behavioral signals.
  • Translate ambiguous fraud and risk problems into clear hypotheses, analytical plans, model requirements, and measurable success criteria.
  • Develop machine learning models for fraud detection across account opening, account takeover, and identity risk.
  • Evaluate models using metrics like ROC/AUC/KS/Gini, precision/recall, fraud capture rate, false-positive rate, customer friction, and fraud losses prevented.
  • Develop and validate predictive features using identity, transactional, consumer credit history, device, behavioral, temporal, velocity, network, and third-party data.
  • Write clean, efficient, well-tested Python and PySpark code, and collaborate with teams to bring models and features into batch, retro, or real-time decisioning environments.
  • Monitor feature quality, model performance, population changes, and fraud-pattern drift
  • Design and present analyses for model behavior, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations
  • Follow appropriate standards for data privacy, model documentation, explainability, validation, and governance.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a related quantitative field
  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, statistics, engineering, data science, or another quantitative discipline
  • Direct experience developing fraud-detection, identity-risk, credit-risk, financial-crime, or other adversarial risk models.
  • Demonstrated experience creating meaningful fraud features
  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with experience writing modular and tested code for large datasets and distributed or cloud data systems.
  • Experience using common data science and machine-learning tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or comparable technologies.
  • Knowledge of supervised learning, model evaluation, feature selection, statistical inference, experimentation, and model calibration.
  • Experience navigating challenges common to fraud modeling, including class imbalance, delayed or incomplete labels, changing attack patterns, and model drift.
  • Experience moving models beyond experimentation and into production, either directly or in close partnership with engineering teams.

Benefits/Perks:

  • Great compensation package and bonus plan
  • Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K
  • Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office
  • Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays
  • Explore all our exciting benefits here:

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose-driven culture is multi award-winning. We have won World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few.

Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @ email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of a recruitment process.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job-related skills, experience, and education. You will be eligible for a variable pay opportunity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

We’re looking for a Category Manager to help us scale our newest categories - Home & Garden, Sports, and Kids - and unlock even more opportunities for customers across Europe to buy refurbished products. You’ll own the growth strategy, leverage data to identify the biggest opportunities across supply, demand, and the on-site experience, and ensure we consistently deliver a competitive and attractive offering to customers.

You’ll report to the Category Management Team Lead and work closely with the Head of New Categories.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in a category management or commercial analytics role, in a dynamic e-commerce and/or marketplace environment.
  • Highly analytical and structured — you turn data into clear insights and prioritised actions.
  • Strong commercial acumen — you understand marketplace supply and demand dynamics.
  • Experienced in project management — you thrive working with cross-functional teams and drive impactful results across them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Growth mindset — persistent, proactive, and a hands-on problem solver.
  • AI-advocate — you use the latest tools and technologies to work smarter and faster.

  • Define the mid-term category growth strategy, including targets, assortment priorities, and category-specific opportunities to unlock growth.
  • Identify and close assortment gaps (subcategories, brands, top-selling products) by working closely with the respective business developers and account managers.
  • Constantly assess category performance, stock availability, and attractiveness; trigger sourcing and commercial actions to improve performance where needed.
  • Prioritise initiatives to improve the on-site category experience, product presentation, and customer journey with our product team, based on competitor insights and customer data.
  • Automate processes so you spend more time understanding insights and crafting recommendations rather than doing analysis.

AI Engineer

Location

Insight at a Glance

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

As an AI Engineer, you will design and implement production-grade AI agents and multi-agent systems that use tools, call APIs, reason over enterprise data, and power modern mobile, web, and Power Platform experiences. We will count on you to be a hands-on delivery consultant focused on building AI and Agentic AI applications. Along the way, you will get to:

  • Design and implement agentic AI systems using Microsoft Foundry (tool/function calling, multi-step and multi-agent workflows).
  • Build and manage tools and connectors along the agentic chain (MCP-based tools, custom tool APIs, enterprise integrations).
  • Develop RAG and data-centric AI capabilities using Azure AI/Cognitive Search and other data sources.
  • Implement prompt strategies, guardrails, and evaluation loops to improve reliability, safety, and quality.
  • Be AmbITious:This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of professional software development, including 2+ years leading technical delivery on client-facing or cross-functional projects.
  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features to production: tool/function calling, structured outputs, multi-step or multi-agent workflows, and the failure modes that come with them.
  • Experience building retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, including chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, and relevance tuning with Azure AI Search or a comparable vector store; familiarity with Foundry IQ and agentic retrieval is a plus.
  • Practical experience with evaluation and safety for LLM applications: building eval sets, measuring quality and regressions, and implementing guardrails, content filtering, and prompt-injection defenses.
  • Strong C#/.NET skills building production APIs and services, with the ability to work in Python where the AI tooling demands it.
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript, enough to build and integrate front-end experiences that consume agentic back ends.
  • Experience delivering on Microsoft Azure (App Service or Functions, Storage, Key Vault, Application Insights or equivalent monitoring) and building with Microsoft Foundry, including Foundry Agent Service and Foundry Models.
  • Experience designing and integrating tools and connectors for agents, such as MCP servers, custom tool APIs, or enterprise system integrations.
  • Comfort operating as a consultant: scoping work with clients, communicating trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and adapting to different codebases and organizations.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework (the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen) or comparable frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, or the Claude Agent SDK.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform (Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate) and integrating custom AI services with it.
  • Experience with observability and tracing for LLM applications (OpenTelemetry, Foundry tracing and evaluations, or similar).
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications such as AI-103 (Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate) or AI-200 (Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate); prior AI-102 or AZ-204 also welcome.
  • Contributions to open-source AI tooling or published technical writing.

What You Can Expect

We're legendary for taking care of you, your family, and helping you engage with your local community. We want you to enjoy a full, meaningful life and own your career at Insight. Some of our benefits include:

  • Freedom to work from another location, even an international destination, for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

Join Us Today, Your AmbITious Journey Starts Here.

Insight is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

At Insight, we celebrate diversity of skills and experience, so even if you don't feel like your skills are a perfect match, we still want to hear from you!

Insight does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. Unsolicited resumes will be treated as direct applications from the candidate, and recruiters or agencies who submit candidates for this position without a prior, written vendor agreement will not be eligible for any form of compensation, even if the candidate is hired.

Salary:The base salary range for this position is typically $150,000 to $160,000 CAD with additional bonus and benefits available. However, compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case, including experience and location, and we will also consider candidates outside of this range as necessary.

  • Aisance à agir comme consultant(e) : cadrer les travaux avec les clients, communiquer les compromis à des parties prenantes non techniques et s’adapter à différents environnements de code et organisations.

Ce qui nous distingue réellement, ce sont nos valeurs fondamentales de Hunger, Heart et Harmony, qui guident tout ce que nous faisons, qu’il s’agisse de bâtir des relations avec nos coéquipiers, partenaires et clients ou d’avoir un impact positif dans nos collectivités.

Joignez-vous à nous dès aujourd’hui. Votre parcours AmbITieux commence ici.

This is a remote position.

Cloud Security Engineer, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Remote (East Coast)

Summary:

  • Job Title: Cloud Security Engineer
  • Level: Senior (7+ years in cybersecurity or cloud engineering, including 3+ years securing AWS environments)
  • Openings: Multiple
  • Security Clearance: U.S. citizenship required. Must be able to obtain and maintain a CBP Public Trust background investigation. An existing DHS Public Trust (CBP, ICE, USCIS, CISA, or another DHS component) is preferred; other federal clearances, including Secret or Top Secret, will be reviewed and may require additional processing.
  • Work Type: Remote: East Coast working hours, with travel approximately once per quarter; candidates in the Washington, DC area preferred
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Agency name: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Department of Homeland Security
  • Start Date: Immediate. Start follows a favorable suitability determination and completion of customer onboarding.

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting skilled and experienced Cloud Security Engineers. This position supports a four-year U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) program to move the agency's applications to the cloud; our client is the prime contractor and incumbent. CBP has set a goal of moving all 276 of its applications to the cloud by January 2028 while advancing a zero trust architecture. Cloud Security Engineers secure those environments, build security into delivery pipelines, and keep systems in line with federal controls such as NIST. The role is fully remote on East Coast hours and requires U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a CBP Public Trust.

Our client is an IT solutions and services company based in Alpharetta, Georgia, founded in 2000 to build mission-critical systems that run around the clock. Its cloud experts design and build cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, with work spanning cloud strategy and architecture, cloud modernization and engineering, security and compliance, cloud DevOps, and data and analytics. Federal civilian agencies are a core part of that work, supported through a GSA Multiple Award Schedule contract, and the company is an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner.

What will you do

Secure the AWS environments that host CBP mission applications. You will implement and operate cloud security controls, build security checks into delivery pipelines, manage vulnerabilities, and support the Authority to Operate (ATO) and continuous monitoring process. You will work with platform engineers, developers, and CBP security staff to make security proactive and built in, not an after-the-fact compliance exercise.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement security controls for AWS environments, including IAM, network segmentation, encryption and key management (KMS), and logging.
  • Configure and operate AWS security services, including Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config, CloudTrail, Inspector, and WAF.
  • Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines: static and dynamic code analysis, container image scanning, and infrastructure-as-code scanning.
  • Run vulnerability management: scan, prioritize, and track findings to remediation through POA&Ms.
  • Support ATO and continuous monitoring: map controls to NIST SP 800-53 and DHS 4300A, gather evidence, and update system security plans.
  • Harden systems, containers, and Kubernetes clusters to DISA STIGs and CIS Benchmarks.
  • Support zero trust architecture work, including identity-based access, micro-segmentation, and least privilege.
  • Detect and respond to security events using SIEM tools such as Splunk; support incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Automate security checks and remediation with Python, AWS Lambda, or policy as code.
  • Review cloud architectures and changes for security risk and advise engineering teams.

Requirements:

  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Able to obtain and maintain a CBP Public Trust background investigation.
  • At least seven (7) years of experience in cybersecurity, cloud, or systems engineering, including at least three (3) years securing AWS environments.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS IAM, VPC security, KMS, and AWS native security services.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, the Risk Management Framework (RMF), and federal ATO processes.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning tools (Tenable/Nessus, Qualys, or Prisma Cloud) and SIEM platforms such as Splunk.
  • Experience securing containers and Kubernetes.
  • Scripting in Python or Bash; infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Able to work remotely on East Coast hours and travel approximately once per quarter.

Desired Skills

  • CISSP, CCSP, or AWS Certified Security Specialty.
  • Experience with DHS 4300A, Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM), and FedRAMP.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud (US).
  • Experience supporting DHS or CBP systems.
  • A current DHS Public Trust (CBP, ICE, USCIS, CISA, or another DHS component).

What you'll do

  • Serve as senior owner on a set of our largest sports and entertainment partnerships, setting pricing strategy with each partner, defending it, and revising it as the market moves
  • Own the commercial health of those relationships, including renewal posture, escalations, and regular engagement with partner leadership
  • Set and move prices across the event lifecycle, from presale through day-of, against sell-through targets, price realization, and spoilage risk
  • Decide what inventory to hold, what to release, how to distribute it across channels, and when a position needs to be worked down rather than defended
  • Manage the ongoing partner relationship through weekly and event-level reporting, regular strategy check-ins, and candid conversations when the market disagrees with the plan
  • Mentor traders earlier in their careers and review their pricing work on high-stakes events
  • Answer partner research questions on marketplace behavior, demand drivers, and season or event projections, then turn one-off requests into repeatable outputs the whole team can run
  • Spot gaps in what we offer, such as services partners keep asking for, manual workflows that should be automated, or places AI tooling could sharpen a call, and lead pilots and builds of the solutions, including shaping our internal pricing and market intelligence products
  • Close the loop after events with analysis of what pricing decisions actually produced, and carry it into the next cycle
  • Travel roughly 20% of the year or more, concentrated in season and carrying a larger share of the team's on-site load, for partner site visits and business reviews, live events alongside partner teams (including evenings and weekends), industry conferences, and team offsites

What you have

  • Bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, statistics, sports management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of experience in ticket pricing, revenue management, trading, or a comparable analytical commercial role, including at least 2 years as the owner of client or partner relationships, preferably in sports, live entertainment, or another dynamic-pricing industry
  • Real sports knowledge: you understand how standings, schedules, rivalries, star players, and playoff races move demand, and can talk shop credibly with people who've worked in sports their whole careers.
  • Genuine awareness of live entertainment, including how touring, on-sales, and routing shape demand
  • Significant experience in ticket pricing, revenue management, trading, or a comparable analytical commercial role, including ownership of pricing decisions with real money attached
  • A track record as the senior owner of a significant commercial relationship, having carried a book rather than just executed within one
  • Experience being accountable when a partnership is under strain, not only when it's performing
  • Experience bringing others along through mentoring, reviewing work, or setting the standard others followed
  • Fluency with sell-through, price realization, ATP, GTV, and inventory aging, and the judgment to know when the model is telling you something and when it isn't.
  • Comfort in spreadsheets and BI tooling, including reading and questioning data you didn't produce
  • A concrete example of turning a one-off analysis into something reusable so nobody had to answer it from scratch again
  • Nice to have: experience on the rightsholder side (club, league, venue, or promoter) or with a secondary marketplace, exposure to commercial deal structuring, and familiarity with data analytics concepts and workflows

Perks

  • Equity stake
  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
  • A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave
  • 401(k) matching
  • Student loan matching program
  • Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
  • $500 per year for wellness expenses
  • Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
  • $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
  • Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

The salary range for this role is $112,000 - $162,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages within that range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.
