Job Title: Product Leader - Data

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

At Veeva Data Cloud, we are building the next generation of data products and software for the global Life Sciences industry across Clinical and Commercial domains.
As a Product Leader on the Data team, you will head a cross-functional squad of data engineers, data scientists, analysts, and operations managers. You will be responsible for defining the product strategy and driving end-to-end execution. This includes high-throughput data pipelines and curation tools to web applications and direct data APIs. In this role, you will leverage both modern GenAI and traditional technologies to innovate constantly, ensuring unmatched data quality and operational efficiency.

What You'll Do

    • Drive Strategy and Execution. Define, own, and execute the roadmap for impactful data products that serve internal teams and external customers
    • Lead Cross-Functional Squads. Direct multi-disciplinary teams from 10 to 100 FTEs toward a shared product vision
    • Deliver Data and Product Excellence. Establish key success metrics, design quality assurance frameworks, and ensure high-standard features are seamlessly deployed into production
    • Innovate continuously. Apply cutting-edge tools such as GenAI, and human-in-the-loop data curation, analytics, and software applications
    • Engage Users and Stakeholders. Conduct user interviews, gather insights, and closely collaborate with core Software Product and Engineering teams to align roadmaps

Requirements

    • 10+ Years of Experience in Product Management. Basics from designing ERD to understanding high-level product patterns that determine long-term success
    • Data Product Track Record. Demonstrated experience driving data-centric product management (data pipelines, analytics, APIs, or data platform tools)
    • AI and Automation Mindset. Proven track record of leveraging AI and automation technologies to boost speed, efficiency, and data quality
    • Technical and Analytical Depth. Ability to dive into operational details, including human data curation workflows and complex data quality metrics, without losing sight of the strategic big picture
    • Cross-Functional Leadership. Proven ability to rally cross-functional technical teams (engineering, data science) around a unified outcome
    • Core Attributes are fast learner, team-first attitude, exceptional work ethic, and strong communication skills

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Health and wellness programs
    • Social events for your team and across teams
    • Personal budget for charity

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 120,000 - 220,000 EUR
    • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Description

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, can multitask, and is a proven team player. You will design, develop, manage, and maintain our open-source data platform, including our Data Lakehouse (S3, Apache Iceberg, and ClickHouse), ETL processes, and orchestration.

What You Will Do

  • Develop a scalable data platform integrating multiple sources for easy access.
  • Design and enhance data tools (orchestration, governance, data lakehouse, BI, etc.).
  • Ensure smooth operation of data systems for analysts, scientists, and engineers.
  • Optimize data pipelines (ingestion, processing, and output) in a microservices environment.
  • Build, maintain, and monitor ETL/ELT processes .
  • Troubleshoot and improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of the data infrastructure (S3, Apache Iceberg, ClickHouse).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, analysts, and backend engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions.
  • Implement and champion data quality, governance, and security best practices across the platform.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data infrastructure role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with data modeling.
  • Experience with data lake/lakehouse architectures (e.g., Apache Iceberg, S3, or similar).
  • Experience with analytical / columnar databases (e.g., ClickHouse or similar).
  • Experience building and orchestrating ETL/ELT pipelines .
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala/Java.
  • Experience working within a microservices architecture and cloud environments (AWS preferred).
  • Self-motivated, strong multitasking skills, and a demonstrated team player.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (or similar technologies) for large-scale data processing.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Note: this role is focused on batch data processing (not real-time streaming).

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with and contributing to open-source data platforms and tools.
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Superset, Looker, Tableau, Metabase, or similar).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with AWS EMR and running Apache Spark workloads in a cloud environment.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to boost engineering productivity.

raw.description:
Location: home-based; ideally South Africa or another location in similar time-zone
Duration of contract: 1 year (possibility for extension)
Supervisor: Global Coordinator for PMER, Complaints and Safeguarding

Start date: as soon as possible

Lutheran World Federation (LWF) World Service
LWF World Service is the humanitarian and development arm of the Lutheran World Federation. We are a widely recognized, international, faith-based organization working in more than 20 countries globally. We seek to bring people of all backgrounds together in the common quest for justice, peace, and reconciliation in an increasingly complex and fragmented world. A commitment to the human rights of every individual, regardless of their status, guides our work, actions, and operations. We are particularly known for our timely, compassionate, and professional humanitarian work, and for our field presence in hard-to-reach areas. Our work is people-centered and community-based. Above all, we work with the most vulnerable, and to claim and uphold their rights, we engage proactively with local government and community structures. For additional information, please see LWF World Service.

Purpose
Complaints and PSEA Advisor supports the Global Coordinator PMER, Complaints and Safeguarding in the implementation and strengthening of complaints handling and PSEA systems across LWF World Service.

The position provides operational and technical support in complaint intake and case management, investigations, CRM monitoring and reporting, PSEA, capacity strengthening, and digital and knowledge management. The position requires a high level of confidentiality, sound judgment and the ability to work independently while knowing when matters need to be escalated to the Global Coordinator.

The Advisor works closely with CRM and PSEA Focal Points in LWF Country Programs to support consistent implementation of LWF policies, systems and requirements across the Country Programs. The position also works with relevant Geneva-based functions, when required.

Required qualifications
University degree in a relevant field such as social sciences, law, human rights, international development or another related field.
Recognized training or certification in investigations.

Knowledge and experience
At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in complaints handling, investigations, PSEA, safeguarding or related areas.
Practical experience in complaint intake, assessment, referral and case management.
Good knowledge of complaints handling, PSEA and safeguarding standards and practices in humanitarian and development contexts.
Experience conducting workplace or misconduct investigations, including interviews, evidence review and investigation reporting.
Experience providing training, coaching or technical support, preferably in humanitarian or development settings.
Experience working with digital information systems, databases or collaboration platforms.

Language skills
English required: fluent

French and/or Spanish are an asset

LWF Core Skills

Achieving results – advanced*

Accountability – resourced

Working effectively with others - advanced
Analytical thinking - advanced
Initiative - advanced

Leadership - resourced

LWF Functional Skills

Attention to detail - advanced

Capacity building / Training – advanced

Confidentiality Management – advanced
Analytical Thinking - resourced

Information Management – advanced

  • LWF 3 skills levels are: basic - advanced – resourced

Main duties
Complaints Handling and Investigations
Supports the day-to-day management of the LWF Complaint mailbox, including acknowledgment, initial assessment, referral, intake analysis, registration and follow-up of complaints.
Reviews and analyses complaints and recommends appropriate handling or escalation in line with LWF policies and procedures.
Maintains accurate and confidential case information in the complaints database and supports CRM Focal Points with complaint handling and documentation.
Conducts or supports investigations when assigned, including planning, interviews, evidence review and preparation of investigation reports.
Acts as the designated backup for the LWF Complaint mailbox during the absence of the Global Coordinator and ensures continuity of complaint handling.

CRM Monitoring, Systems and Implementation
Supports the monitoring of CRM implementation across Country Programs and follows up identified gaps with CRM Focal Points.
Coordinates the quarterly CRM reporting process, reviews the quality and completeness of submissions and follows up where information is missing or incomplete.
Supports the review and improvement of the CRM quarterly reporting tool and process.
Supports the rollout and consistent use of ActivityInfo for complaint recording and monitors the quality and completeness of information recorded by Country Programs.
Reviews CRM information and complaint data to identify recurring gaps, trends and areas requiring additional support.

PSEA
Supports the Global Coordinator with the review, update and rollout of the LWF World Service PSEA Policy.
Provides technical support to PSEA and CRM Focal Points on the implementation of PSEA requirements at Country Program level.
Supports and follows up PSEA self-assessments and UN PSEA assessments, including review of evidence, identification of gaps and follow-up of agreed actions.
Develops and delivers PSEA induction, training and refresher sessions and supports focal points in strengthening staff awareness.
Identifies recurring PSEA gaps and brings significant or systemic issues to the attention of the Global Coordinator.

Capacity Strengthening and Technical Support
Supports the induction and onboarding of new CRM Focal Points and provides ongoing coaching and technical support to CRM and PSEA Focal Points.
Develops and delivers practical training and refresher sessions on complaint handling and CRM based on identified needs.
Supports focal points in strengthening complaint mechanisms and related processes and facilitates learning and exchange between focal points when useful.

Digital Systems and Knowledge Management
Reviews and organizes existing CRM, complaints, investigation and PSEA resources, helping to reduce duplication, archive outdated materials and simplify the resources available to Country Programs.
Supports the development and maintenance of a structured SharePoint site where Country Programs can easily access current guidance, templates, training materials and other resources related to Complaint and PSEA.
Supports the effective use of ActivityInfo, SharePoint and other relevant digital systems and works with Data & Analytics and other colleagues when technical support is required.

Major Challenges
Handling sensitive and confidential information while managing several priorities at the same time.
Supporting more consistent implementation of CRM and PSEA requirements across different Country Program contexts.
Turning policies and technical requirements into practical and user-friendly approaches.
Managing multiple priorities, taking initiative and ensuring timely coordination on sensitive or complex matters.

raw.description:
Oracle Cloud Technical Architect

Location: Canada – Remote

Department: Finance

Position: Oracle Cloud Technical Architect

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei. Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We are dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission

Nuvei is looking for an Oracle Cloud Technical Architect to lead the Oracle technical layer of the UFS Reimagined program within the Global Finance organization. The program is delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and EPM across the Nuvei finance landscape in two waves, alongside a systems integrator and a number of specialist partners for 3rd party solutions being implemented in parallel. This role sits on the Nuvei side of that program and holds the Oracle technical authority for Global Finance.

The person in this role sets the standard and stands behind it. They will review and approve the integration architecture proposed by the systems integrator, define connectivity, identity, and environment requirements across the Oracle ecosystem, lead the architecture and security clearance work for the Oracle connections to Kyriba and Sovos, and cover the Oracle Integration Cloud posting path from the business rules platform into the general ledger. Where a design decision has to be made, defended, or refused, this person makes it.

The role reports to the Director, Oracle Solutions and works in close collaboration with functional business process leads, the systems integrator's technical team, Nuvei's enterprise architecture and information security teams, the incoming application managed support partner, and the owners of the upstream and downstream systems that Oracle Fusion Cloud connects to. It is a hands-on architecture role, not a coordination role, and it continues beyond go-live as the permanent Oracle technical owner within Nuvei.

This role will suit someone with ten or more years of Oracle technical experience, including several full Fusion Cloud implementation lifecycles from requirements through cutover and hypercare, who has carried architecture accountability through a security and compliance approval process and has taken a newly implemented ecosystem into a sustained support model.

Responsibilities

The role covers four areas. The balance of work shifts across the program, moving from integration architecture and clearance work during the build, through cutover and hypercare at each wave, into sustained ownership of the Oracle ecosystem once the application managed support model is running.

Integration Architecture and Oracle Integration Cloud

  • Review the systems integrator's solution design for every in-scope interface and confirm the appropriate Oracle Integration Cloud or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure integration pattern, including orchestration, scheduling, retries, idempotency, and recovery behaviour.
  • Define endpoints, authentication, service accounts, certificates, encryption, privileged access, network routes, and environment-specific configuration for each connection between Oracle Fusion Cloud and the surrounding application ecosystem.
  • Facilitate the technical discussions between the systems integrator and the peripheral system teams, covering systems governed by Finance, Corporate-IT, systems outside its current footprint, and third-party managed platforms, and hold the functional and technical flow of each interface.
  • Document the standards the build is held to for orchestration, scheduling, retries, error handling, logging, monitoring, and alerting, and review partner-produced designs against them.
  • Own the Oracle Integration Cloud posting path from the business rules platform on Azure and Snowflake into the Oracle general ledger, including file-based data import, aggregated journal delivery, drill-back lineage, and reconciliation points.
  • Lead architecture checkpoints during build and testing, approve deviations from the agreed standards, and authorize the technical transition of each interface into production.

Architecture, Security, and Cloud Clearances

  • Lead the Oracle side of the architecture and security clearances required for Oracle Fusion Cloud to connect to the Kyriba and Sovos cloud platforms, both of which hold Nuvei data on third-party infrastructure and clear on their own merits.
  • Produce the evidence the enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, and third-party risk forums require, including context and data-flow diagrams, control assessments, test results, and remediation status.
  • Translate approval conditions into actionable design, configuration, testing, and evidence requirements, and drive them to closure with the partner, vendor, security, and infrastructure teams before production deployment.
  • Contribute the Oracle integration and technical assurance view to the business rules management platform being built on Nuvei's own Azure tenant, including its architecture and security clearance packs.
  • Confirm environment topology, segregation, capacity, availability, performance, scalability, configuration management, deployment paths, and separation of duties across the Oracle landscape.
  • Accept the formal handover from the enterprise and infrastructure architects, validating decisions, conditions, accepted exceptions, dependencies, risks, and open actions, and carry them forward as the standing Oracle technical authority.

Post Go-Live Sustainment and the Hybrid Support Model

  • Represent Nuvei in the selection and onboarding of the application managed support partner, including responses to vendor clarifications, evaluation of proposed support models, and technical assessment of the bids.
  • Own the in-house share of the hybrid support model, covering infrastructure, IT service management, and the portion of the integration ecosystem that is retained rather than outsourced.
  • Lead the knowledge transition from the systems integrator into Global Finance and the support partner, and confirm that support ownership, service expectations, incident routing, and escalation paths are agreed for every production interface.
  • Govern the hypercare period at each wave, then the steady-state support model, ensuring month-end close and year-end are treated as the critical windows they are.
  • Define the technical side of the proactive operations monitoring model, including thresholds, observability, alert routing, dashboards, and the runbooks each participating team operates from.
  • Carry wave-one lessons into wave-two readiness for the larger and more complex regional scope and maintain technical authority for clearance-related changes and exceptions through the sustainment period.

Environment, Ecosystem, and Technical Governance

  • Own the Oracle Fusion Cloud environment landscape, including refresh planning, environment scheduling across workstreams, quarterly update readiness, and regression coverage.
  • Govern the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure tenancy supporting the ecosystem, including compartments, identity domains, policies, network topology, service limits, cost, and service health.
  • Set the technical standards for Fusion security, including role design support, data access sets, and segregation of duties, and review changes against them.
  • Assess non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, auditability, and supportability before any build is approved.
  • Review deployment and support artefacts, approve the final technical evidence and handover, and ensure the ecosystem remains compliant and supportable after implementation.

Requirements

  • Ten or more years of hands-on Oracle technical experience, including multiple full Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation lifecycles from requirements through cutover and hypercare.
  • Demonstrated architecture accountability on an Oracle Fusion Cloud program, including ownership of integration architecture, technical standards, and design approval across a partner-delivered build.
  • Deep, current Oracle Integration Cloud experience covering orchestrations, adapters, mappings, fault handling, scheduling, and the review of designs produced by others.
  • Strong command of Oracle Fusion Cloud integration surfaces, including REST and SOAP web services, the ERP Integration Service, file-based data import, and business events.
  • Practical Oracle Cloud Infrastructure experience across identity and access management, compartments, policies, networking, and service limits, sufficient to govern a tenancy rather than only operate in one.

raw.description:
About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the Role

We're looking for an exceptional product leader to join our Consumer Product team as Director of Product Management. This team is responsible for building a delightful digital consumer experience — from onboarding users and helping them understand their families' needs, to purchasing the right insurance products to protect what matters most. As Director, you will own the strategy and execution of our core consumer product surface, leading a team of product managers and partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Marketing. The ideal candidate combines first-principles thinking, deep consumer empathy, and organizational leadership to drive both team excellence and meaningful business outcomes. You'll set the vision, build the team, and be accountable for results at scale. We're looking for an entrepreneurial product leader who is passionate about advocating on behalf of users, building and developing high-performing PM teams, and driving sustainable business growth — all while operating with a high degree of ownership in a product-first company.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Leadership & People Management

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product managers, fostering a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement
  • Set clear goals and development plans for direct reports; conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching
  • Partner with recruiting to grow the PM team as the business scales, identifying talent and building a strong hiring pipeline
  • Create clarity and alignment across the team on priorities, roadmap, and success metrics

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for the Consumer Product team, aligned to company strategy and growth objectives
  • Translate business goals into clear product bets, sequenced for maximum impact and learnings
  • Identify new market opportunities — including new insurance products such as Indexed Universal Life and Whole Life — and develop go-to-market strategies to capture them
  • Stay ahead of consumer trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies to inform the product strategy

Execution & Delivery

  • Own the end-to-end consumer experience, from top-of-funnel acquisition through purchase and onboarding, driving measurable improvements to conversion rates and user satisfaction
  • Educate consumers on the need for Life Insurance and empower them to purchase the right type and level of coverage for their families
  • Champion a culture of rapid experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, and use results to drive product decisions with rigor and speed
  • Remove friction from the application experience and identify opportunities to motivate users toward completion and coverage
  • Ensure all consumer experiences are built on a foundation of accessibility, delight, and simplicity

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Serve as the senior product voice in cross-functional forums, influencing roadmap prioritization and resource allocation decisions
  • Build strong working relationships with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Actuarial partners
  • Communicate product strategy, progress, and results clearly to executive leadership and the broader organization
  • Drive alignment on shared goals across product, engineering, and business teams to ensure cohesive execution

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • 8+ years of experience as a product manager at a high-growth technology company, building consumer products at significant scale
  • 3+ years of experience managing and developing product managers, with a track record of growing high-performing PM teams
  • Experience in fintech, insurtech, or other regulated consumer industries is a plus
  • Exceptional ability to generate, test, and refine hypotheses using a blend of data, user insights, and market trends — ensuring product decisions are both innovative and impactful
  • Strong analytical orientation with a focus on data-driven decision making; ability to measure success rigorously across a portfolio of bets
  • Proficiency in self-serve analytics using tools like SQL and Amplitude; comfort partnering with data science for complex analysis
  • Proven ability to transform strategic ideas into actionable roadmaps, rapid prototypes, and iterative, feedback-driven product improvements
  • Demonstrated experience leading and scaling PM organizations, including hiring, onboarding, and developing talent
  • Ability to operate effectively at multiple altitudes — from setting long-term vision to rolling up sleeves on execution when needed
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence; ability to influence without authority across functions and levels
  • Deep track record of solving hard customer problems and translating them into durable business growth

About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is seeking an experienced Legal Operations Manager to lead the end-to-end customer contracting process and oversee the daily operations of the Contract Operations function.

This role is responsible for ensuring customer contracts move efficiently through review, approval, execution, and operational handoff while maintaining compliance with established contracting processes and providing visibility throughout the contract lifecycle. The Contract Operations Manager will drive process improvements, optimize CLM and Salesforce workflows. This position operates as part of the Legal Department and partners closely with Sales, Finance, Service Delivery, Security, and Customer Success.

The ideal candidate combines strong contract management experience with a process improvement mindset and the ability to build scalable, efficient contracting operations.

How You Will Make An Impact

Contract Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle for customer contracts, including SOWs, Change Orders, MSAs, service agreements, amendments, renewals, and related commercial documents.
  • Oversee contract intake, review, approvals, redline coordination, execution, retention, and archival.
  • Ensure contractual documentation is complete, properly approved, and consistent with established contracting standards and processes.
  • Coordinate effective handoff of executed contracts to downstream business teams.

Contract Operations & Process Improvement

  • Reviewing Statements of Work and related commercial documentation for completeness, consistency, operational readiness, and compliance with approved contracting standards prior to execution.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve contracting workflows and partner with Legal, Sales, Service Delivery and other stakeholders to recommend and implement process improvements.
  • Identify process bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions that improve efficiency, visibility, and cycle times.
  • Drive automation initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve stakeholder experience.
  • Establish and maintain service-level expectations and operational controls.

Governance & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and Legal, coordinating contract reviews, issue identification, risk escalation, and resolution of contractual matters.
  • Review and coordinate negotiation of customer MSAs, SOWs, amendments, and other commercial agreements, including identification and escalation of contractual, operational, and commercial risks in accordance with established approval processes and contracting guidelines.
  • Support approval matrices, playbooks, templates, and contracting standards.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for contract process guidance and issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Service Delivery, Security, and Customer Success to ensure smooth contract execution and operational readiness.

Systems & Reporting

  • Serve as the business owner for contract lifecycle management processes and related systems.
  • Manage and optimize contract workflows within CLM and Salesforce platforms.
  • Maintain contract repositories, reporting, documentation standards, and data integrity.
  • Develop reporting that identifies bottlenecks and process inefficiencies across the contracting lifecycle.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Contract Operations team.
  • Establish team priorities, workload management practices, and performance expectations.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service.

What You Will Bring To The Table

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Contract Operations, Contract Management, Contract Administration, Legal Operations, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting technology services, managed services, outsourcing, cloud, cybersecurity, professional services, or consulting agreements.
  • Experience supporting customer contracts, SOWs, Change Orders, and commercial agreements.
  • Strong experience with Salesforce and contract-related business processes.
  • Experience working with or administering a Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform.
  • Strong project management, stakeholder management, and process improvement skills.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with DocuSign CLM or similar CLM platforms.
  • Experience within a technology services, managed services, consulting, or SaaS organization.
  • Experience implementing workflow automation and process optimization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled workflow and contracting solutions.

The successful candidate will:

  • Improve contract turnaround times without sacrificing compliance or quality.
  • Increase visibility and accountability throughout the contracting process.
  • Streamline workflows through automation and process simplification.
  • Strengthen adoption of CLM and Salesforce contracting processes.
  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Service Delivery, and Operations.
  • Develop a scalable Contract Operations function that supports company growth.

Argentina (any part of the country its great for us!)

Shift

  • Happy club: Pedidos Ya

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • English in company.
  • Ability to work remotely.

About Us

At Netrix Global our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals and commit us to a common purpose.

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today’s most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country’s top system integrators.
At Netrix, we’re driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.

📍 Location: Pakistan (Fully Remote)

About the Opportunity

Let us help you develop your career to become a data scientist.

TensorOps is an applied-machine-learning studio that helps organisations across Europe and North America design, train, and deploy production-grade GenAI systems. Our team blends research depth with pragmatic engineering. We're looking for an enthusiastic and curious analyst based in Pakistan to join our fully remote team and help us understand and communicate the business impact of our cutting-edge AI solutions.

This is an entry-level opportunity for someone passionate about data, who wants to learn how advanced AI models are creating real-world value.

What We're Working On

As a Junior Data Scientist, you will support projects that are at the forefront of the AI industry. You'll have the chance to analyze the performance and impact of:

  • AI Copilots & Autonomous Agentic Systems — from copilots in hospitals, financial advisor agents, and manufacturing bots
  • High-Performance Search & Recommendation — large-scale recommender systems and search solutions like Elasticsearch, vector databases, and text-to-SQL
  • Decision-Support Tools — systems for critical applications in adtech, finance, and e-commerce

Core Stack You'll Use & Learn

  • Core Tools: Python, SQL, and advanced AI-assisted coding
  • Visualisation: Matplotlib, Seaborn, and/or tools like Tableau, Looker
  • What You'll Be Exposed To: Large Language Models (LLMs), LangChain, MLflow, AWS, and GCP

The Role

As a Junior Data Scientist, you will be the analytical engine of our project teams. You will dive into project data to uncover insights, evaluate model performance from a business perspective, and help translate complex technical results into clear, actionable recommendations for our clients.

You will:

  • Analyze Performance Data — work with data generated by our AI models to measure their effectiveness, identify trends, and understand user behaviour.
  • Research and Evaluate Models — support senior team members by researching new AI and machine learning approaches, summarizing their capabilities and potential business applications.
  • Translate Technical to Business — collaborate with ML engineers to understand how models work, and then articulate their value and limitations in a business context.
  • Create Reports & Presentations — develop clear, concise reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to internal teams and client stakeholders.
  • Support Project Teams — assist in the discovery phase of new projects by analyzing client data and identifying opportunities where AI can solve key business challenges.

About You

  • You are a recent graduate or have 0-2 years of professional experience in a data analysis, business intelligence, or related role
  • Strong foundational skills in Python for data analysis (especially Pandas, NumPy) and SQL for data querying
  • A natural curiosity for technology and a strong desire to learn about machine learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; you are comfortable explaining analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • An analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and great attention to detail
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau) is a plus
  • A BSc or MS in a quantitative field such as Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline
  • Based in Pakistan, with working hours that overlap with our European team

Why TensorOps?

  • Learn from the Best — work alongside and learn from experienced ML engineers and researchers on high-impact projects. This is a unique opportunity for mentorship in the applied AI space.
  • Real-World Impact — your analysis will directly influence project direction and help industry-leading clients understand the value AI brings to their business.
  • Grow Your Career — you will gain hands-on experience with the most advanced AI technologies in the industry. We offer a clear path for professional development in a rapidly growing field.

Ready to start your data science journey? Apply now!

raw.description:
ELEVI is seeking a senior DDI Architect with deep network engineering expertise and hands‑on experience delivering enterprise‑class DNS, DHCP, and IPAM solutions. The role is 75% post‑sales engineering, focused heavily on Infoblox implementations, migrations, upgrades, and tech refreshes, while also supporting EfficientIP, BlueCat, and TCPWave platforms. The remaining 25% involves pre‑sales technical support, helping drive new‑business capture through demos, discovery, and solution design.

If you excel at both architecting DDI solutions and engaging with customers, this role places you at the center of ELEVI’s most strategic work.

Post‑Sales Engineering (75%)

  • Architect and implement Infoblox‑based DDI solutions across enterprise and global environments.
  • Lead DDI migrations, including Microsoft DNS/DHCP transitions and platform‑to‑platform IPAM migrations (Infoblox, EfficientIP, BlueCat, TCPWave).
  • Execute system upgrades, re‑architecture efforts, and tech refreshes for customer DDI environments.
  • Provide lifecycle engineering and architectural guidance — not day‑to‑day system administration.
  • Produce high‑quality documentation, design artifacts, diagrams, and knowledge‑transfer materials.
  • Ensure successful delivery through best‑practice design, testing, validation, and cutover planning.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, guiding long‑term DDI strategy and modernization.

Pre‑Sales Technical Support (25%)

  • Deliver compelling DDI and DNS Security presentations, product overviews, and live demos.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions to uncover customer requirements, challenges, and business drivers.
  • Support sales cycles with solution design, POC/POV engagements, and RFP/RFI responses.
  • Map customer needs to ELEVI’s DDI architecture, migration, and DNS Security offerings using value‑based framing.
  • Translate customer requirements into architectural recommendations, scopes of work, and value‑driven proposals.
  • Partner with Account Executives to identify and shape new‑business opportunities.
  • Contribute to sales and marketing collateral, solution diagrams, and technical content.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise DDI engineering experience with deep expertise in DNS, DHCP, IPAM, ISC BIND, Kea DHCP, NTP, TCP/IP.
  • Strong hands‑on Infoblox experience (core requirement); Infoblox certifications strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead DDI migrations, including Microsoft DNS/DHCP transitions and large‑scale platform‑to‑platform IPAM migrations.
  • Experience with EfficientIP, BlueCat, or TCPWave (highly desirable; training provided).
  • Solid understanding of DNS Security (DNSSEC, RPZ, threat‑intel filtering).
  • Python and/or Perl scripting required, with proficiency in bash/ksh/csh, APIs, CLIs, VPN, SSH, data migration, and service integration.
  • Broad networking and systems background: Linux/Unix, routing/switching, load balancing, MS Active Directory, VoIP, UDP, and related infrastructure.
  • Strong foundation in Backup & Disaster Recovery, fault‑tolerant systems, and upgrade planning.
  • Excellent communication skills — confident presenting to all levels, leading whiteboard sessions, and translating complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Experience supporting sales cycles, POCs, demos, RFP/RFI responses, and collaborating with Account Executives, partners, and cross‑functional teams.

Why ELEVI

At ELEVI, you won’t just implement technology – you’ll shape the future of how global enterprises run their most critical network services. We’re a boutique powerhouse: small enough for your voice to matter, but trusted by some of the world’s largest organizations to solve their hardest DDI challenges. You’ll work alongside top‑tier architects who are known across the industry for their depth, precision, and ability to deliver flawlessly in high‑stakes environments.

Here, you’ll own high‑impact architectural work, not day‑to‑day administration. You’ll lead migrations, modernizations, and redesigns that materially improve how customers operate. You’ll be empowered to innovate, influence technical direction, and build long‑term relationships with customers who rely on your expertise.

We invest in our people – through continuous learning, OEM training, certifications, and opportunities to work across Infoblox, EfficientIP, BlueCat, TCPWave, and emerging DDI technologies. You’ll grow your skills, expand your architectural range, and become a recognized expert in a niche that’s only increasing in strategic importance.

If you want to do meaningful work, solve complex problems, and be part of a team where excellence is the baseline…… ELEVI is where you belong.

Our employees value the flexibility at ELEVI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Connexus Credit Union - Who We Are:

Serving members across all 50 states, Connexus Credit Union is a member-focused cooperative that is proud to return profits to member-owners through high yields for checking accounts and deposit products, as well as competitive rates on our loans. We are a remote first employer with the majority of our employees residing in the upper Midwest.

As an employer we foster collaboration and high performance to achieve excellence. We holistically care for and develop our employees to thrive personally and professionally. We are proud to share our success with our employees and those we serve.

Connexus offers an Amazing Benefits package:

  • 25 days of paid time off and 10 paid holidays
  • 16 hours of paid Volunteer Time Off
  • 401K Retirement with up to 6% employer match
  • Excellent Health, Dental, Vision insurance, including multiple plan options
  • Health Savings Account with generous employer contributions
  • Employer paid Life insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Tuition Reimbursement from $4,000 - $7,000 per calendar year
  • Robust Learning and Development program that includes an annual professional development stipend

About the Role:

We are looking for a Data Scientist who enjoys solving business problems and using data to help people make better decisions. You'll partner with teams across the organization to identify opportunities, build models, and turn data from Snowflake and other sources into recommendations that drive business outcomes. You will also play a key role in building our conversational analytics capabilities and expanding how we use AI to better serve our members and employees. We're looking for someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by making a difference.

Responsibilities:

  • Develops data science solutions that utilize machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical and quantitative modeling to develop predictive and prescriptive analytics.
  • Applies and integrates statistical, mathematical, predictive modeling and business analysis skills to manage and manipulate complex data from a variety of sources.
  • Creates visualizations, including dashboards, to display data-backed insights and predictive results.
  • Works across a wide range of related areas including data extraction and cleansing, feature engineering, machine learning, exploratory analysis, data quality analysis, experimental analysis.
  • Partners with other teams to create and deploy Data Products that create member and/or business value.
  • Executes data science and analytics projects, including, but not limited to enterprise projects, run-the-business, and other special projects.
  • Participates in and communicates the status of projects with respect to milestones and schedule commitments.
  • Leads data discovery sessions and documents needs in a way that can translate into work requirements for other team members.
  • Elicits requirements using interviews, document analysis, requirements sessions, data descriptions and definition, use cases, scenarios, and data analysis.
  • Validate hypotheses, identify growth opportunities, and influence direction for process improvement with analyses, experimentation or other scientific methods.
  • Develops quality assurance test plans and direct quality assurance testing.
  • Adheres to data science best practices, documentation requirements, and BT standards and guidelines.
  • Prepares and delivers reports, recommendations, or alternatives that address existing and potential trouble areas across the organization.
  • Adheres to data science policies and procedures.
  • Works closely with data engineers, analysts, and team members to support data-driven projects.
  • Mentors data analysts.
  • Fosters business and IT relationships to understand key needs and form collaborative strategic partnerships.
  • Seeks opportunities to improve department efficiency and reduce expenses by streamlining operations.
  • Comply with all Federal Regulations as they pertain to your job duties including Bank Secrecy Act.

Position Requirements:

  • This position is Remote.
  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, applied mathematics, statistics, or machine learning is Required.
  • 5+ years of prior experience in data scientist role is Required.
  • 1 + year of data science roles or equivalent experience including working with stakeholders is Required
  • Experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning (ML/AI) algorithms for supervised & unsupervised learning, and natural-language processing (NLP) to business problems and goals is Required.
  • Proficient in SnowFlake, Python, R, SQL, and basic machine learning is Required.
  • Proficient in using data visualization tools. Excellent communications skills, including the ability to simplify recommended action plans from complex data science project is Required.
  • Must be able to understand and analyze data and rapidly generate actionable results.
  • Ability to influence and communicate complex analysis & insights to a non-technical audience.

  • 2026 Best Place to Work in IT, Computer World

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Kafka Platform Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually (based on experience)
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Kafka Platform Engineer with 10+ years of experience in distributed systems, event streaming, and platform engineering, including extensive expertise with Apache Kafka and the Confluent Platform. The ideal candidate will architect, deploy, and manage enterprise-scale streaming platforms that power mission-critical, real-time data processing across the organization. This role requires deep technical expertise in Kafka internals, platform automation, security, observability, and cloud-native infrastructure, along with the ability to mentor engineering teams and define enterprise event-streaming standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, deploy, and manage highly available Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments supporting enterprise-scale event-driven applications.
  • Design Kafka cluster topology, broker configuration, partitioning strategies, replication, capacity planning, and performance optimization for high-throughput workloads.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security using SASL, SSL/mTLS, ACLs, RBAC, encryption, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Design and manage Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, and event streaming pipelines for real-time data integration.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, or similar automation frameworks to provision and manage Kafka infrastructure.
  • Design and implement High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, failover, and cross-region replication strategies.
  • Build comprehensive monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, and Confluent monitoring tools.
  • Optimize cluster performance, troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement long-term platform improvements.
  • Support Kafka deployments on Kubernetes using Strimzi, Confluent Operator, or managed cloud services including AWS MSK, Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API), and Confluent Cloud.
  • Collaborate with application developers, data engineers, DevOps, SRE, and enterprise architects to establish event-driven architecture standards and best practices.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, establish platform governance, perform code reviews, and mentor engineers on Kafka development and operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years of hands-on Apache Kafka or Confluent Platform experience.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Kafka internals, including partitions, replication, brokers, ISR, consumer groups, offset management, and performance tuning.
  • Extensive experience implementing Kafka security using SASL, SSL/mTLS, ACLs, RBAC, and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, and real-time event streaming architectures.
  • Experience implementing High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), multi-cluster replication, and cross-region failover strategies.
  • Advanced scripting skills using Python, Bash, or Go, along with Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, and distributed tracing solutions.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Confluent Certified Administrator or Confluent Certified Developer certification.
  • Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes using Strimzi, Confluent Operator, or similar operators.
  • Hands-on experience with managed Kafka services including AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API), or Google Cloud Managed Kafka.
  • Experience with stream processing technologies such as Apache Flink, Apache Spark Structured Streaming, or Apache Beam.
  • Knowledge of data governance, schema evolution, metadata management, and data lineage for streaming platforms.

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Research shows that women and underrepresented groups only apply to jobs only if they think they meet 100% of the qualifications on a job description. IMO Health is committed to considering all candidates even if you don’t think you meet 100% of the qualifications listed. We look forward to receiving your application!
IMO Health is a clinical data intelligence business at the heart of a digital revolution in healthcare. Combining rich, highly nuanced medical terminology, extensive domain knowledge, and artificial intelligence (AI), we expertly structure and operationalize clinical data to generate sharper insights and inform more intelligent decision-making. Deeply embedded in the provider world, we developed a comprehensive intelligence layer that captures and encodes patient encounters with unmatched completeness and precision. Now, by weaving ethical and accountable AI into this robust content, we are improving how data is used across the healthcare landscape with powerful new applications in health tech, drug discovery, population health, and payer processes.

IMO Health is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Director to join our growing Healthcare (Non-Provider) Sales team, an area of significant investment as we expand into new markets and accelerate growth. This individual contributor role will be responsible for driving new business with healthcare technology organizations, particularly companies building products and solutions that rely on healthcare data, clinical terminology, analytics, or AI.

As a Business Development Director, you will sell IMO Health’s clinical terminology, data quality, and knowledge graph solutions to organizations looking to improve the quality, consistency, and usability of healthcare data. You’ll engage with organizations ranging from healthcare IT and analytics companies to population health platforms and emerging AI and agentic AI companies.

This is a true hunter role for someone who enjoys opening new markets, navigating complex sales cycles, and solving customer problems through a consultative approach. No two opportunities will be the same, and success will require the ability to understand a customer’s business and technology challenges, connect those challenges to IMO’s capabilities, and build a compelling path to value.

You’ll play a critical role in expanding IMO Health’s market presence and revenue while helping healthcare technology companies unlock greater value from their data.

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:

  • Drive growth by targeting and securing new business opportunities within healthcare IT organizations, effectively positioning IMO Health’s solutions.
  • Boost revenue by developing and executing strategic sales plans that achieve and surpass financial targets.
  • Cultivate and manage strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers to expand IMO Health’s client base and strengthen market presence.

WHAT YOU’LL LEARN:

  • Gain deep exposure to how healthcare technology companies leverage clinical data, terminology, and AI to build and enhance their products.
  • Expand your understanding of emerging applications of knowledge graphs, NLP, and AI within healthcare technology.
  • Develop new approaches to bringing complex data and technology solutions to market across a diverse range of healthcare organizations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Identify and Secure New Opportunities: Proactively identify, qualify, and advance new business opportunities with healthcare technology organizations, from established platforms to emerging AI companies.
  • Develop Strategic Sales Plans: Build and execute account and territory strategies designed to generate new business and achieve revenue goals.
  • Understand Customer Needs: Engage with business, product, technology, and executive stakeholders to understand their challenges and connect them to IMO’s clinical terminology, data quality, and knowledge graph capabilities.
  • Drive Consultative Sales: Navigate complex, solution-oriented sales cycles by developing a clear understanding of customer requirements, addressing objections, and collaborating with internal teams to shape the right solution.
  • Build Executive Relationships: Establish credibility and trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers, including C-suite and senior technology and product leaders.
  • Manage Pipeline: Build and manage a healthy revenue pipeline, ensuring opportunities progress effectively through each stage of the sales cycle.
  • Present and Communicate Value: Deliver compelling presentations, proposals, and other sales materials that clearly articulate the business and technical value of IMO’s solutions.
  • Forecast and Report: Maintain accurate forecasts and CRM data while providing clear visibility into pipeline, opportunities, and expected revenue.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • 12+ years of enterprise sales or business development experience, with a strong track record in healthcare and experience selling to healthcare technology organizations.
  • Strong understanding of the healthcare market and the ability to understand how healthcare data is created, managed, exchanged, and used across technology products and solutions.
  • Demonstrated success hunting for and closing new business, including experience developing leads, building pipelines, navigating complex sales cycles, crafting proposals, and closing high-value subscription or recurring-revenue accounts.
  • Current understanding of technology and AI, with the ability to credibly engage customers in conversations about how AI and emerging technologies depend on high-quality, well-structured healthcare data.
  • Experience with clinical terminology, healthcare data quality, code sets, or the relationships among clinical domains such as medications, labs, and problems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, NLP, or related data/AI technologies is a plus.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and earn trust across technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to use data and customer insights to shape sales strategies and recommendations.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and energized by opening new markets and creating opportunities where there is not yet an established playbook.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform and experience using CRM data to manage pipeline and sales performance.
At IMO Health, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. IMO Health is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.
Visa sponsorship may be available for select positions at IMO Health. Qualified candidates who require sponsorship are encouraged to apply.

raw.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

The AMER Marketing Operations Manager serves as a strategic revenue intelligence counterpart and senior advisor to our VP of Field Marketing for AMER region (US, Canada, LATAM & FED). This role drives operational efficiency, AI-enabled transformation, planning rigor and analytical support across the regional marketing organization, ensuring that field marketing investments are measurable, scalable, and aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.

This is a senior, builder-oriented role: the Business Partner is expected to design and deliver agentic AI capabilities — not just champion them — while owning the planning, pipeline target, and performance narrative for AMER.

What You’ll Do

  • Field Marketing Partnership - Serve as the strategic operations counterpart and senior advisor to the AMER VP of Field Marketing and her leadership team. Provide budget decision support, performance insights, pipeline forecast support and operational guidance. Provide enablement and trainings for the AMER Marketing team based on new tools & metrics
  • Performance Measurement & Analytics - Own AMER reporting on pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, event performance, and funnel health. Oversee dashboards, KPI forecasting, and data audits in partnership with the analytics center of excellence. Deliver executive-ready insights and QBR materials for the VP and CMO organization
  • AI Building & Agentic Decision Interface - Contribute to the design, delivery, and iterations on new Veeam Agentic interfaceswhich will help optimize budget efficiency and signal-to-pipeline conversion across marketing. Translate intent, account, and engagement signals into prioritized account lists & further personalization, reallocate spend toward highest-yield programs, and surface real-time recommendations to field marketing and SDR leaders
  • Efficiency & Process Improvement - Identify and remove operational friction across campaign execution, lead management, and reporting workflows designed by marketing operations center of excellence. Contribute to standardize processes across sub-regions while respecting local nuance
  • Cross-FunctionalAlignment - Partner with multiple internal teams (Sales Operations, Sales Excellence, CT, Sales Acceleration, Channel Marketing, Data Science, Data analytics etc.) to ensure data integrity, attribution accuracy, and consistent definitions across the AMER GTM motion
  • GTM support - Support quarterly budget reviews preparation (QBRs), management meetings, budget reallocations, and ROI analysis. Ensure spend is tracked against plan and tied to outcomes
  • Annual Planning & Target Setting - Lead AMER marketing planning cycle. Build and deliver Marketing-sourced and SDR-sourced pipeline creation targets by sub-region, segment, and channel. Model investment & organizational scenarios and align targets with capacity and revenue goals

What You’ll Bring

  • Master's degree expected, in Business, Marketing, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field. English fluency required
  • 5–10 years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or other GTM strategy role in SaaS or specialized consultancy
  • Familiarity with AMER markets GTM dynamics, including LATAM and Canada nuances
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management across time zones, data-driven storytelling for non-technical audiences, and the ability to influence in a matrix organization
  • Ability to drive cross-functional projects successfully
  • Demonstrated experience in designing, building, and scaling AI agents and/or automation in a marketing or operations context
  • Proven ability to build pipeline models, set defensible targets, design attribution frameworks, and translate data into executive recommendations. Strong understanding of CLV/LTV, CAC, ROI, and funnel metrics
  • Experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and Marketo (including Marketo Measure / AEP for attribution)
  • Hands-on experience with BI/visualization tools such as Tableau is appreciated

Bonus Skills

  • Familiarity with any of the following is a plus: LeanData, 6sense, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Content syndication integrations, Monday.com (or equivalent PPM), Confluence, and emerging GTM engineering tools (e.g., Clay)

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time

  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.
