AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

The Principal Data Consultant is a senior consulting leader who serves as the Engagement Lead and primary executive advisor across the full client engagement lifecycle. This role is accountable for client success, delivery excellence, financial performance, executive stakeholder relationships, strategic direction, and overall engagement outcomes.

Principal Data Consultants lead complex data, analytics, AI, cloud, and digital transformation initiatives by aligning business objectives to technology solutions that deliver measurable value. They set engagement strategy, establish governance, guide executive decisions, mitigate risk, and ensure delivery quality, transparency, and operational discipline. On smaller engagements, they may also act as Project Manager; however, their primary responsibility is strategic engagement leadership while enabling Project Managers and delivery teams to execute successfully.

Beyond client delivery, Principal Data Consultants help advance the Data Practice by developing future leaders, improving consulting methodologies, shaping service offerings, supporting business development, and contributing to the long-term growth and maturity of the practice.

Roles & Responsibilities

    Client Delivery

  • Own the success of complex engagements, including delivery quality, client satisfaction, financial performance, business outcomes, and strategic account growth.
  • Serve as the primary Engagement Lead and executive advisor, building trust and maintaining executive relationships throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Define engagement strategy, governance, communication cadence, success measures, and executive reporting.
  • Lead executive steering committees, governance meetings, roadmap workshops, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Partner with Project Managers, Solution Architects, and Technical Leads to ensure execution aligns to client objectives with the right level of executive oversight.
  • Provide strategic direction across workstreams to maintain alignment with business priorities, contractual commitments, and long-term client goals.
  • Proactively manage executive risks, organizational change, stakeholder alignment, staffing challenges, and delivery issues before they affect outcomes.
  • Ensure engagements meet AHEAD quality standards, delivery methodologies, financial objectives, and governance expectations.
  • Provide executive-level recommendations that support informed decisions and measurable business results.

    • Business Development and Account Growth

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with executive business and technology leaders, including CIOs, CDOs, CISOs, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to expand client engagements through a deep understanding of client priorities, organizational challenges, and business goals.
  • Lead discovery workshops, executive strategy sessions, and solution development efforts that shape future engagements.
  • Partner with Client Directors and Practice Leadership to develop account strategies, multi-phase roadmaps, and long-term growth plans.
  • Lead proposal strategy, solution development, estimation, pricing discussions, and executive presentations.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible, operationally executable, financially sound, and aligned to client outcomes.

    • Practice Leadership and Growth

  • Evolve consulting methodologies, engagement frameworks, governance standards, reusable intellectual property, and delivery best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement that enhances delivery quality, operational excellence, financial performance, and client satisfaction across the Data Practice.
  • Mentor and coach Senior Consultants, Consultants, and emerging Engagement Leads through leadership guidance, performance feedback, and development support.
  • Build organizational capability by supporting recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, succession planning, leadership development, and career growth.
  • Promote collaboration across consulting, delivery, architecture, engineering, project management, sales, and client success teams.
  • Maintain expertise in emerging technologies, industry trends, business transformation strategies, and modern data platforms while representing AHEAD as a trusted industry advisor.

Expectations

    Principal Data Consultants are expected to consistently demonstrate executive leadership, strategic thinking, business acumen, consulting excellence, and accountability while driving successful client engagements and advancing the Data Practice.

    Leadership and Ownership

  • Demonstrate end-to-end ownership for engagement success across delivery quality, client satisfaction, financial performance, and strategic outcomes.
  • Establish clear direction, priorities, governance, and accountability across cross-functional teams.
  • Make timely, informed decisions that balance business priorities, delivery risks, financial objectives, and client expectations.
  • Anticipate challenges early, remove organizational obstacles, and lead teams through complexity with confidence and transparency.
  • Develop future leaders through coaching, mentoring, delegation, and growth opportunities.

    • Consulting and Business Acumen

  • Understand client strategies, organizational priorities, industry trends, and operational challenges.
  • Translate business strategy into practical roadmaps and transformation initiatives.
  • Connect engagement activity to measurable business value, value realization, and long-term client success.
  • Make financially sound decisions that protect profitability while maximizing outcomes.
  • Influence executive decisions through strategic insight, business-focused recommendations, and thoughtful guidance.

    • Technical and Consulting Excellence

  • Apply structured thinking and consultative problem solving to complex business and technology challenges.
  • Guide solution strategy and ensure recommendations are practical, scalable, technically sound, and aligned to business objectives.
  • Challenge assumptions, evaluate alternatives, and provide a clear point of view grounded in business and technical rationale.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and technical excellence across engagement deliverables.
  • Advance consulting excellence by improving methodologies, frameworks, accelerators, and reusable intellectual property.

    • Executive Relationships and Stakeholder Management

  • Build long-term trusted advisor relationships through credibility, integrity, and consistent delivery.
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently with a business-first perspective to influence executive decisions.
  • Facilitate alignment across business and technology stakeholders while managing competing priorities and organizational dynamics.
  • Proactively identify concerns, resolve conflict, and build consensus to enable successful outcomes.
  • Represent AHEAD with executive presence, professionalism, and a commitment to exceptional client service.

    • Practice Leadership and Growth

  • Lead initiatives that strengthen consulting capabilities, delivery excellence, governance, and operational maturity across the Data Practice.
  • Develop and mentor future Engagement Leads and consulting leaders through coaching, feedback, and leadership development.
  • Contribute to business development, practice strategy, service offerings, innovation, and thought leadership.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and consulting excellence.
  • Serve as a role model for AHEAD values, leadership principles, and client-first culture.

Qualifications

    Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Business, or a related field.
  • Typically 12–15+ years of progressively responsible experience leading enterprise data, analytics, AI, cloud, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Minimum seven years of consulting or professional services experience leading complex enterprise engagements.
  • Demonstrated success as an Engagement Lead, Program Lead, or senior consulting leader for large, cross-functional transformation initiatives.
  • Proven experience managing executive client relationships, engagement financials, delivery governance, organizational change, and strategic account growth.
  • Experience leading executive workshops, steering committees, governance forums, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud technologies, governance, and modern architecture principles.

    • Core Competencies

  • Executive leadership with the ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Exceptional consulting skills, including structured thinking, consultative problem solving, strategic planning, and executive communication.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology investments to measurable business outcomes.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple teams while maintaining accountability for engagement success.
  • Excellent relationship management, facilitation, negotiation, conflict resolution, and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong financial management skills, including forecasting, margin management, budget oversight, and commercial decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, build high-performing teams, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, professionalism, and the ability to lead through influence.

    • Preferred

  • Master’s degree or MBA.
  • Professional certifications in cloud platforms, enterprise architecture, project management, Agile, AI, or data management.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, or similar enterprise technologies.
  • Experience leading enterprise modernization, operating model transformation, data strategy, governance, AI adoption, or large-scale digital transformation programs.
  • Experience developing consulting offerings, strategic partnerships, or practice growth initiatives.

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

BSN SPORTS, A VARSITY BRANDS COMPANY - THE RECOGNIZED LEADER IN TEAM ATHLETIC GEAR

For over 50 years, BSN SPORTS has been the largest team sporting goods equipment and apparel distributor of choice in the United States. Our 3,000 BSN SPORTS employees strive to support the Heart of the Game by putting valuable time back into the day of coaches and administrators through excellent service platforms. Our company mission is simple: Save coaches and administrators time with everything they do off the field so they have more time to impact young lives on it.

Location: Remote

Travel- Approximately 20% to 25%. Some out-of-area and overnight travel may be required.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

BSN SPORTS is seeking a strategic, commercially minded leader to help shape the next phase of growth for the Collegiate Select division. This high-impact role brings together new business development, partner activation, customer success, and campus-wide expansion across the Midwest Territory. The role builds trusted relationships with athletic departments and university leaders, opens new opportunities, ensures signed agreements become successful partnerships, and creates repeatable systems that strengthen adoption, retention, satisfaction, and growth. Serving as a critical link among customers, Field Sales, global brand partners, and other BSN teammates, this leader delivers an exceptional partner experience from the first conversation through long-term expansion and reports to the Senior Vice President of Collegiate Select.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at anytime with or without notice.

  • Within a defined territory, develop a deep understanding of each partner’s goals, needs, and operating rhythms.
  • Create and manage a robust growth and renewal pipeline.
  • Leverage existing industry relationships and create new connections to accelerate customer acquisition and expand BSN’s reach without relying solely on Field Sales involvement.
  • Lead the commercial process by delivering compelling sales presentations, guiding commercial discussions, negotiating effectively, and executing new and renewal agreements.
  • Expand existing partnerships by connecting athletics with other campus departments to increase adoption, grow volume, and maximize customer value.
  • Support onboarding, activation, and early success by guiding institutions through contract activation, local sales alignment, systems setup, branding workflows, product education, and service introduction.
  • Raise the standard for business reviews by establishing a disciplined approach that identifies service risks, adoption gaps, and growth opportunities, then coordinates proactive solutions that strengthen retention and partnership health.
  • Execute numerous collegiate RFPs and bids each year, collaborating with the go-to-market operations team and cross-functional teammates to enhance procedures and efficiencies.
  • Serve as the Collegiate Select expert, aligning Field Sales, territory teams, support teams, and campus stakeholders around clear plans, the right products and solutions, and exceptional service.
  • Enable stronger Field Sales execution by advising strategy, coaching, tools, and change leadership that improve effectiveness, close rates, CRM discipline, order processes, and collegiate licensing compliance.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to create market-specific campaigns, presentations, communication frameworks, engagement programs, and resources tailored to Varsity Athletics.
  • Maintain exceptional CRM documentation and use company platforms to track pipeline activity, customer visits, quarterly business reviews, and follow-ups.
  • Use data, customer feedback, and performance trends to improve activation speed, satisfaction, adoption, retention, expansion, and operational efficiency.
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Strategic leadership: ability to translate long-term opportunity into practical plans and strong day-to-day execution.
  • Exceptional business acumen in selling, negotiation, contract management, strategic planning, executive account management, and problem solving.
  • Proven customer focus and ability to build durable internal and external relationships that create long-term value.
  • Executive communication skills with the confidence and clarity to influence senior executives, institutional partners, and internal teams.
  • Ability to collaborate across functions, align teams, and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Strong organization and accountability while managing competing priorities and tight deadlines with attention to detail, urgency, clarity, and ownership.
  • Sound and timely decision-making that balances customer outcomes, organizational goals, risk, and opportunity.
  • Action-oriented approach demonstrating initiative, resilience, energy, opportunity recognition, and follow-through.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM platforms, with the ability to use business intelligence and AI tools to manage activity, reporting, and execution.

Success Indicators

  • Strong growth and renewal pipeline.
  • Fast and consistent partner activation.
  • High adoption and retention rates.
  • Meaningful account expansion and customer value growth.
  • Stronger Field Sales execution and disciplined CRM practices.
  • Trusted long-term collegiate partnerships and high partner satisfaction.

Education, Certification and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Residence in a Midwest Territory state preferred but not required.
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in collegiate sales, business development, strategic partnerships, account management, customer success, onboarding, or related roles.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in customer-facing, strategic, or operational roles.
  • Collegiate sales experience required. Experience working in or with collegiate athletics or university environments is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success presenting to, influencing, and building relationships with executive-level customers and complex organizations.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Physical Demands and/or Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job.

OUR VALUES

Service - We lead with heart. We champion community.

Passion - We love what we do. It fuels our purpose.

Integrity - We do what we promise. We own our actions and decisions.

Respect - We earn it by giving it. Because everyone deserves it.

Innovation - We never stop striving to be better. For ourselves and our community.

Transparency - We are committed to openness and honesty in everything we do.

OUR BENEFITS

We are committed to putting you and your families first. For benefits eligible roles, we offer a variety of choices and costs as well as program enhancements that align with our responsibility to elevate the employee experience. Some of our offerings include:

  • Comprehensive Health Care Benefits
  • HSA Employer Contribution/ FSA Opportunities
  • Wellbeing Program
  • 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Company paid Life, AD&D, and Short-Term Disability
  • Generous My Time Off & Paid Holidays
  • Varsity Brands Ownership Program
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Access to Financial Coaching and member-owned Credit Union
  • St. Jude Partnership & Volunteer Opportunities
  • Employee Perks including discounts on personal apparel and equipment!

Eligibility for company-sponsored benefits is determined by scheduled work hours, and the terms of the applicable benefit plans. Benefit offerings and eligibility requirements may vary by position and are subject to change in accordance with plan documents and applicable law.

In this role you will be responsible for the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from translating business requirements into robust technical designs, to writing production-quality code, to deploying cloud-native services and supporting them through their full operational lifespan. The Customer Success Engineer (CSE) acts as a trusted advisor for the customer in achieving customer outcomes, value and success with Cribl solutions. This highly technical role needs to coordinate and strategize across several functions to enable customers to realize continuous value. raw.description:
Manske Mobile Medicine is seeking an experienced Medical Administrative & Operations Virtual Assistant to support the launch and ongoing operations of a growing medical practice.

This is a hands-on, process-oriented role for someone with strong medical administrative experience who can manage back-office responsibilities while also helping establish efficient workflows, organize documentation, and create structure around the practice's administrative processes.

The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, comfortable working independently, and able to identify gaps in a process and help develop practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle prior authorizations and follow up on authorization requests.
  • Perform insurance verification and confirm patient coverage and benefits.
  • Process and coordinate referrals and related documentation.
  • Request, organize, and maintain medical records.
  • Manage faxing, document transmission, and follow-up.
  • Organize and process patient forms and ensure required documentation is completed.
  • Maintain accurate and organized electronic patient records.
  • Support day-to-day back-office medical administration.
  • Help determine where forms and documentation should be stored, uploaded, signed, and processed.
  • Assist in organizing workflows between Elation, Spruce, and Hint.
  • Help establish and document efficient administrative processes and standard operating procedures.
  • Identify workflow gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Help create systems for tracking tasks, follow-ups, referrals, authorizations, and other administrative activities.
  • Potentially answer incoming patient calls and provide general administrative support.
  • Communicate clearly and patiently with patients, including a significant elderly patient population.
  • Support the practice with additional administrative and operational tasks as processes are established and the practice grows.

Process & Operations Support

A major component of this position will be helping the practice build its administrative infrastructure.

The selected candidate should be comfortable with:

  • Creating and improving workflows.
  • Organizing processes from the ground up.
  • Establishing clear procedures for recurring administrative tasks.
  • Helping determine how different systems should be used together.
  • Creating tracking systems and accountability processes.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Developing or monitoring KPIs and performance metrics when appropriate.
  • Documenting processes so they can be consistently followed.

This role is ideal for someone who has previously taken ownership of medical office processes, administrative operations, or team workflows.

Clear verbal communication is especially important because the practice serves a significant number of elderly patients. The selected candidate must be easy to understand, patient, professional, and comfortable explaining administrative processes to patients.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is more than a task-oriented medical VA. They are a self-directed medical administrative professional who can help build structure within a growing practice.

You should be comfortable saying:

"This process isn't working efficiently. Here's how I would organize it."

You should be able to take ownership of administrative responsibilities while helping the practice determine how its systems, forms, documentation, and workflows should work together.

If you have experience with prior authorizations, insurance verification, referrals, medical records, EMRs, and healthcare operations, and you enjoy creating order and improving processes, we would like to hear from you.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in medical administration, healthcare operations, medical office management, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with prior authorizations.
  • Experience with insurance verification.
  • Experience handling referrals and medical records.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. healthcare administrative processes.
  • Experience managing patient forms, documentation, faxing, and back-office workflows.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of processes.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and patiently with elderly patients.
  • Comfortable working in a role where responsibilities and workflows may evolve as the practice launches.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Elation EMR.
  • Experience with Spruce or similar healthcare communication platforms.
  • Experience with Hint or similar healthcare/payment platforms.
  • Previous medical office management or healthcare operations experience.
  • Experience managing or coordinating a team.
  • Experience creating KPIs, SOPs, workflows, or performance tracking systems.
  • Experience helping a new medical practice establish administrative processes.
  • Clinical or healthcare-related experience.

Systems

The practice currently uses:

  • Elation – EMR
  • Spruce – Patient communication
  • Hint – Additional practice platform

Experience with these systems is valuable, particularly Elation.

Benefits

Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST | Remote

The hourly rate will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, background, and level of expertise.

raw.description:
About the Client
Our client is a leading luxury e-commerce platform known for its trunk show model, giving customers early access to runway collections from top designers before they hit stores. The business spans women's fashion, fine jewelry, beauty, and home, curating exclusive product from a roster of established and emerging luxury designers. This is a fast-paced, trend-driven environment where buying decisions directly shape the customer experience.
Why does this role exist?
This role exists to support the Fine Jewelry team's Buyer in building and executing a merchandise assortment that hits sales and profit targets, at a time when the category needs dedicated hands-on support through a defined project window (running through January/February 2027). The Assistant Buyer will handle the analytical and operational backbone of the buying process — reporting, inventory balancing, PO management, and vendor coordination — so the Buyer can focus on strategic assortment and vendor decisions. Ultimately, this hire exists to help the Fine Jewelry category run smoothly and grow during a critical stretch of the business.

The Impact you’ll make

Merchandising Buying Support
  • Assist the Buyer in developing merchandise assortments, sales, and inventory plans for assigned departments
  • Help build assortment models and balance inventory to maximize category performance
  • Support execution of buying decisions and processes across the organization
Reporting Trend Analysis
  • Produce sales trend reports for the Buyer's review
  • Project merchandise requirements for assigned departments based on sales data
  • Monitor performance against plan and flag risks/opportunities
Order, Vendor Inventory Management
  • Enter and manage purchase orders (POs)
  • Monitor shipments, deliveries, RTVs, and transfers
  • Perform vendor pricing updates and maintain accurate vendor records
Process Execution Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Execute appropriate processes and decisions across relevant teams
  • Manage PCA (price change authorization) requests and consignment viewings
  • Act as a reliable point of coordination between the Buyer and other departments

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:
  • Prior experience in merchandising, ideally within fashion, luxury goods, or a related retail category.
  • Solid understanding of the fashion and luxury goods industry, along with the consumer and market trends affecting it.
  • Strong grasp of merchandising financials and retail math, with the ability to help manage category profitability.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Highly detail-oriented, with strong analytical skills.
Your superpowers are...
  • Technical skills:
    • Advanced Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, reporting/analysis)
    • Retail math fluency (open-to-buy, margin, markdown management)
    • Experience with PO entry and order/vendor management systems
    • Inventory tracking (shipments, deliveries, RTVs, transfers)
    • Sales trend analysis and forecasting
  • Soft skills:
    • Detail-oriented with sharp analytical instincts
    • Excellent organizational and presentation skills
    • Strong written and verbal communicator
    • Team player and natural relationship builder
    • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
WFH Set-Up:
  • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.
  • Internet speed of at least 40MBPS
  • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
  • Back-up computer and internet connection

raw.title: Payroll Implementation Lead
raw.excerpt: About SalsaSalsa is rebuilding the most important piece of the business stack: paying workers.
raw.description:
About Salsa

Salsa is rebuilding the most important piece of the business stack: paying workers. We think workers should be paid faster, more easily, and more transparently, so we build next-generation payroll infrastructure for the future of work.

Salsa is an embedded fintech company. We think payroll belongs inside the tools businesses already love, so we give software platforms the APIs and infrastructure to launch their own modern payroll products. Turning every modern SaaS platform into a payroll provider will finally go after the $50bn a year that goes to legacy payroll providers. We think it's about time.

We're a team of payroll technology experts who love to build. We've worked on this problem at startup stage and at large scale, in the US and abroad. We're well-funded, ready to grow, and we love offsites in interesting corners of the world, so bring your ambition and your passport.

About the Role

Our partners sell payroll to their customers, and we make sure those employers get onboarded and paying their workers. This role starts in the trenches and grows into teaching others how to do it.

First, you'll roll up your sleeves and do the onboarding work yourself. You'll help the employers our partners sign up get set up for payroll: gathering what they need, building their accounts, and getting them to a clean first payroll. Doing the work is how you'll learn where employers get stuck, what partners misunderstand, and what a great onboarding really looks like.

Then, the role evolves into train-the-trainer. Most of our partners are software companies, not payroll companies, and their teams are often new to payroll. You'll educate those teams on onboarding best practices and the payroll knowledge they need to onboard employers on their own, using Salsa for support and guidance. You'll design the training programs, materials and exercises that make payroll concepts click for people who've never run a payroll.

We're still writing the playbook. You'll keep improving our payroll onboarding guidance and processes based on what you learn across partners and employers.

Responsibilities

Hands-on employer onboarding

  • Onboard new employers end to end: company setup, federal, state and local tax accounts and rates, pay schedules, earning and deduction codes, garnishments, benefits, and worker records

  • Move settings and deductions over from the employer's prior provider and confirm they're configured correctly

  • Work with our migration team so each account's configuration and migrated data are ready together for first payroll

  • Audit builds before go-live and catch configuration errors before they reach a paycheck

  • Manage a pipeline of onboardings toward clear go-live dates, chasing down what's missing (tax IDs, registration letters, prior-provider reports) from employers and partners

  • Work directly with employers by Zoom, phone or email to guide them through setup and their first payrolls

  • Know where setup help ends and tax or legal advice begins, and route those questions to the right place

Training and enablement

  • Design and deliver training programs that teach partner teams how to onboard employers onto payroll

  • Create engaging training materials, exercises and job aids across different learning modalities: live sessions, recorded walkthroughs, written guides, hands-on practice and knowledge checks

  • Explain payroll concepts in plain terms to people new to payroll, and check that the learning sticks

  • Train partner onboarding and support teams, and coach them through their first months of live employers

  • Review partner-built accounts, spot patterns in their mistakes, and update the training or process that caused them

Improving the model

  • Turn what works across partners and employers into Salsa's standard payroll onboarding guidance and playbooks

  • Keep training materials current as our product, processes and payroll rules change

  • Spot where onboardings keep breaking, bring specifics to product and engineering, and help automate what should be automated

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years in payroll operations or onboarding, including 2 to 3 years training, coaching or educating people in the payroll operations domain

  • Experience creating training materials and building training programs from scratch

  • Experience educating people new to payroll, and making complex payroll concepts simple and practical

  • Proven skill creating engaging training materials, exercises and learning modalities that people actually use

  • Hands-on payroll onboarding or implementation experience, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and do the work

  • Strong working knowledge of multi-state payroll tax, pre- and post-tax deductions, benefits and retirement (including 401(k)), and garnishments

  • Experience resolving payroll issues directly with employers (PTO, 401(k), deductions, garnishments, W-4s, tax discrepancies)

  • Obsessive about accuracy: a payroll that's a few cents off bothers you until you find out why

  • Comfortable in spreadsheets, including reviewing and uploading YTD balances and mapping settings and deduction data from other providers' reports

  • Clear, patient communicator by Zoom, phone and email

  • Organized enough to run many onboardings and training efforts at once in a ticketing and tracking system (we use Zendesk, Slack and Google Workspace)

  • Wants the startup version of this job: less structure, more ownership, and building the process while doing the work

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a payroll provider, PEO, or embedded payroll or HR platform

  • Train-the-trainer experience: you've taught other trainers or team leads how to teach

  • Experience with employers of 100+ workers or multi-state employers

  • Comfortable in front of partner leadership, explaining what good onboarding really takes

RP Clinical Services (RPCS) and Mosaic Clinical Technologies (Mosaic) tell distinct but connected stories: RPCS speaks to physicians, health systems, and the practices that deliver patient care every day, while Mosaic is a fast growing health technology company redefining medical imaging by shifting radiology from reactive diagnostics to proactive, predictive care.
The Director, Public Relations and Media Strategy leads the day-to-day public relations and earned media strategy for both companies, maintaining the integrity of each narrative while understanding where they intersect and when they should remain separate. This is a senior individual-contributor and building role that creates the operating cadence, relationships, and processes needed to surface important developments early and translate complex clinical, operational, and technology priorities into credible external narratives. The Director also directs agency, freelance, and monitoring support to extend the capacity of the function..
DIRECTOR, PUBLIC RELATIONS & MEDIA STRATEGY - POSITION SUMMARY:
  • Leads the day-to-day public relations and earned media strategy for RPCS and Mosaic, maintaining the integrity of each narrative while identifying where the two intersect and when they should remain separate.
  • Builds and owns a rolling twelve-month editorial and earned-media calendar that anticipates industry moments, including policy shifts, reimbursement changes, clinical society meetings, and technology milestones.
  • Translates complex clinical, operational, and artificial intelligence subject matter into narratives that land with national business, healthcare trade, and technology press.
  • Identifies emerging themes early and converts them into positioning opportunities before competitors define the conversation.

  • Writes and edits releases, statements, bylines, op-eds, and question-and-answer documents.

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, public relations, or a related field, or any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 10+ years in public relations, media relations, or corporate communications, including at least three years leading a function, an agency account of scale, or a major program.
  • Demonstrated results securing high-value national business, healthcare trade, and technology coverage, with a track record of personally developing, pitching, or directing successful stories.
  • Experience in healthcare, health technology, life sciences, or another highly regulated and technically complex industry.
  • Proven crisis and issues management experience with direct exposure to legal and compliance review.
  • Exceptional writing and editing under deadline, with a portfolio that ranges from a two-hundred-word statement to a full-length op-ed.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity across multiple brands, stakeholders, and geographies, with limited existing process to inherit.

Public Relations Marketing Strategy Director

At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. Our powerful giving platform and stellar support enable tens of thousands of nonprofits to raise more, recruit more, and retain more, fueling maximum impact and raising the bar on what’s possible for the nonprofit sector. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year.

We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us!

The Role

As an Outbound Business Development Representative (BDR), you will play a critical role in generating new business opportunities for Bloomerang by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential nonprofit customers who may not be actively looking for a new solution. You will be creating demand where none exists with key decision-makers and setting up qualified meetings for our Account Executives. This role requires resilience, creativity, and the ability to keep focused when you receive rejection. Success comes from your ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, think strategically and personalize your outreach. If you are passionate about sales, and want to make a difference in the nonprofit sector, this role is for you!

What You Will Do

  • Master Bloomerang’s Product & Value: Become an expert on how Bloomerang’s fundraising, donor, and volunteer management solutions transform nonprofits to help them achieve their mission. You’ll need to quickly articulate value to busy decision-makers.
  • Prospect & Engage: Break into cold accounts through research and strategically engaging decision makers through a mix of cold call, email, LinkedIn and personalized messages.
  • Generate Pipeline: Create & nurture a 90-day rolling pipeline of high-quality potential meetings from scratch, using creative and strategic outreach to warm them up and convert to qualified meetings.
  • Sales Collaboration: Partner closely with the Account Executive team to strategically build a pipeline that converts into closed revenue. You'll work together to identify high-potential accounts, refine outreach strategies, and ensure a seamless handoff of qualified opportunities that drive real business impact.
  • Goal Achievement: Consistently meet (and ideally exceed) your business development targets, contributing to Bloomergang's overall success.
  • Data Management & CRM Use: Ensure the accurate maintenance of sales data and lead tracking through Salesforce, keeping a record of all interactions and progress.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 1+ year of sales experience (SDR, BDR, or sales internship preferred) or business experience and a strong interest in SaaS sales.
  • A passion for helping nonprofits and a desire to understand their challenges.
  • A self-starter mentality with the ability to adapt and push yourself every day without relying on warm leads.
  • Resilience and persistence—you’re comfortable with rejection and see it as a learning opportunity.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills—both written and verbal to engage with senior leaders, and handle objections without hesitation.
  • A curious and coachable mindset with a drive to continuously improve.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, 6Sense is a plus.

Benefits

Health + Wellness
You’ll have access to generous health, vision, and dental insurance options as well as HealthiestYou, a healthcare service that offers convenient, confidential access to quality doctors 24/7, anytime, anywhere.

Time Off
You'll get a competitive PTO package that includes 20 PTO days, 3 flex days, 4 optional volunteer days, 12 paid holidays, as well as paid parental leave. More is more!

401kYou'll receive a 401k match to help invest in your future.

Equipment
Everything you need to be successful, shipped right to your door. You got this. We got you.

Compensation
As this is an incentive compensation role, there is a base salary with annual on target earnings of $75,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, as well as applicable employment laws.

Location
This is a permanent, full-time, fully remote position (within the U.S. and select Canadian Provinces only). Employees living in Indianapolis, IN are welcome to work from our company headquarters. We do not offer Visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

raw.description:
The College of Business & Economics is seeking qualified adjunct faculty to teach graduate-level courses in Statistics, Business Analytics, Quantitative Methods, or related areas.. These courses are offered online and include interactive one-hour virtual class sessions on Monday or Tuesday evenings at either 7:00 p.m. or 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time, as assigned. Faculty are also expected to integrate Christian biblical values into course discussions in ways that support thoughtful reflection, ethical decision-making, and applied leadership in professional contexts. In addition, adjunct faculty are expected to participate in a monthly one-hour virtual faculty meeting on Thursday evening at 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time to support program alignment, student success, assessment, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate will bring strong academic preparation, professional experience, Christian faith, and a commitment to engaging graduate students in practical, applied learning. Courses may include topics such as organizational behavior, change management, leadership, organizational culture, team dynamics, and organizational effectiveness.

Primary Responsibilities

The adjunct faculty member will be responsible for teaching assigned graduate courses, facilitating meaningful student engagement, providing timely feedback, assessing student learning, and maintaining regular communication with students. Faculty are expected to align course delivery with program learning outcomes and support the mission of the College of Business & Economics.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must have a graduate credential in organizational behavior, organizational change, management, leadership, or a closely related field, including at least 18 graduate credit hours in the teaching discipline. Relevant professional experience in leadership, management, organizational development, consulting, human resources, or change management is required.

Preferred Qualifications

A Ph.D. or terminal degree in organizational behavior, organizational leadership, management, organizational development, or a closely related field is preferred. Prior graduate teaching experience, especially in online formats, is also preferred.

About our Commitment to Fairness in Employment

Anderson University does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, age, religion, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other basis on which the University is prohibited from discrimination under the local, state, or federal law, in its employment or in the provision of its services, including but not limited to its programs and activities, admissions, educational policies, scholarship and loan programs, and athletic and other University-administered programs. As a Christian institution of higher education, Anderson University is entitled to certain religious accommodations under federal and state law, including Title IX of the Education Amendments Act and Title VII of the Civil Rights Act. raw.description:
Senior Product Engineer: Cloud-Native Tech
Pune, Maharashtra, India | Product Engineering | Full-time | Fully remote

What are we looking for??

  • You are an engineer with an eye for constant improvement. You not only look at improving the code but also tooling, the commands you use, the user-facing documentation, and everything that makes great and beautiful products possible.
  • You can talk fluently to computers: It does not matter if it is Python, Go, Java, NodeJS, or any other widely used and known programming language. Till you know one and you know it well, you fit right in. You believe languages are just tools to solve problems.
  • You really like to solve problems, complex engineering problems!
  • You have some exposure/understanding of systems. Out of curiosity, you tried to understand the routing, load balancing in a web server, or how the Linux filesystem was built and structured the way it is. You may not have worked extensively but you definitely have dabbled with it and can think as well as understand how systems interact with each other.
  • You can express ideas and your opinions and aren’t shy to say no if you don’t know something. We are not hiring Wikipedia after all, are we?

What you will be learning and doing?

  • You will be part of a team-building a product to solve the next generation of problems in the programmable infrastructure. It’s you who will start with defining the feature and how it will make the life of the end-user better and then make it into a reality.
  • You will most likely be programming in Go or Python (not to worry if you have not used them before, some of our best engineers started fresh on these languages after they joined us.)
  • Most likely some part of your work might be open source and worthy of talking and presenting at conferences and meetups.
  • You will be working with cloud-native technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Service Meshes, Distributed Tracing in some shape or form.
  • You will also be working with one or more public cloud platform from AWS/Azure/Google Cloud Platform (again, you may not know any or some of these technologies and that is not a deal-breaker)
  • Your workflow will be driven by tools such as GitHub, Slack, and a lot of asynchronous communication with distributed teams. “GitHub issues” will be your new re-incarnated Jira ;)

Experience:7+ Years

APPLY HERE:

Helping startups & midsize enterprises adopt cloud-native tech with our products and services. #Containers #Kubernetes #CloudNative Experts.

We are working with Bay area-based startups helping them build container orchestration/networking/storage/security products. And on another hand we work with enterprises helping Automotive, FinTech, Energy companies adopt Kubernetes and container ecosystem to modernize their applications and infrastructure.
We are a premier technology company comprising of elite software programmers coupled with have strong experience in Serverless, Container, Container Orchestration, Cloud platforms, Infrastructure automation, SDN, Big Data Infrastructure Solutions.

We are 1st Kubernetes Partner in India, only other in APAC region.
Our deep expertise and focus in these areas enable our customers to build better software, faster.

We are organizers of local chapters of Serverless & Kubernetes Meetup and actively involved in building a community for new technologies in Cloud & DevOps space.

raw.description:
Telehealth Mental Health Therapist – Remote

Please note: This is a state-specific application. If you are not currently licensed in Nebraska, we encourage you to visit www.affect.com to view our active openings by state.

If you do not see a current opportunity in your state, we still welcome you to submit your information through our General Application for Future Openings, also available on our website. We’d love to keep your details on file for future consideration.

About AffectBuilding on our success in substance use disorder care, Affect has expanded its services to include high-quality, accessible mental health treatment. Our model brings together licensed therapists, innovative technology, and a deeply human approach to help people manage anxiety, depression, trauma, and other mental health challenges—on their terms.

As we grow, we’re seeking skilled, compassionate licensed mental health professionals to join our remote care team. If you're a Nebraska licensed LIMHP or LMHP looking to make an impact through virtual care, we’d love to connect.

Our ability to provide supervision for non-independent mental health professionals varies by state and license, but we also encourage you to apply. We try to support non-independent licenses when possible.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct diagnostic assessments and collaboratively develop evidence-based treatment plans
  • Provide individual psychotherapy sessions via secure telehealth platforms
  • Support Members with a wide range of mental health needs, including anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship challenges with flexibility to work with members with substance use disorders at times.
  • Maintain clear and timely clinical documentation in our electronic medical record (EMR) system. Affect provides an AI-powered clinical scribe to assist with documentation, helping reduce administrative burden and allowing clinicians to spend more time focused on member care.
  • Coordinate care as needed and contribute to a supportive, multidisciplinary environment
  • Participate in clinical team meetings and optional case consultations
  • Adhere to HIPAA and all applicable state licensure regulations

Requirements:

  • Active and verifiable license from one of the following Nebraska licenses: LIMHP or LMHP, as well as your state of residence if it is not Nebraska. All credentials must be verified through the State Board’s website as part of the application process
  • Experience providing psychotherapy in outpatient, private practice, or telehealth settings
  • Strong communication and clinical skills with a person-centered, trauma-informed approach
  • Comfort with EMRs, Google Suite or Microsoft Office, and telehealth tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting with professionalism and integrity
  • Have a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace and reliable internet

The Benefits of Joining Affect

  • The salary range for this full-time position is $60,000 - $80,000 and will commensurate with experience and professional license.
  • Full-time employees may enroll in offered medical, dental, and vision coverage and employer paid life and disability insurance also provided.
  • Paid vacation, sick time, company observed holidays and parental leave is provided to full-time employees.
  • Remote work options with full-time and part-time schedules
  • AI-powered clinical scribe technology to streamline documentation and reduce administrative workload
  • Opportunities for continuing education and professional development
  • Supportive team culture focused on impact, collaboration, and innovation
  • Be part of building a modern, inclusive, and accessible mental health care system

Join us as we expand our mission—empowering recovery, healing, and hope through digital-first mental health care.

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

**Travel to Office expectations**

For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

Position Summary:

We are looking for a seasoned Sr. Solutions Analyst who has worked with SaaS software. Your focus is on providing an exceptional customer experience while handling complex technical queries and complaints for our cloud-based healthcare solutions.

We are looking for someone who can prioritize daily tasks to resolve customer problems, independently or with others, in a timely manner using various communication channels.

To do well in this role you need to be able to remain calm while trouble-shooting complex system issues with customers. As well, a strong understanding of administrative tasks and workflows for long term care and medical facilities is crucial to your success.

Reporting to the Sr Manager, Customer Support

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide world class customer support and produce successful outcomes for clients with pressing challenges relating to administration, configuration, and utilization the application.
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of our cloud-based software to support processes and patient care in long term care facilities.
  • Facilitate the resolution of complex technical issues by way of log analysis, research, or problem recreation.
  • Work cross-functionally within the organization, to deliver quality, satisfaction, and resolutions to customers.
  • Effectively use and search the knowledge base, consistently contributing new or updated superior quality content.
  • Enhance, advocate, and exemplify KCS methodologies in addition to authoring and updating knowledgebase content.
  • Works to frequently exceed established service delivery guidelines and key performance indicators.
  • Mentor less experienced team members on trouble shooting SaaS products, customer support best practices, and internal processes.
  • Thoroughly document problems via phone, email, chat, and web portal to accurately record the issue, investigative steps, and resolution using our help desk ticketing system.
  • Be available to work rotating shifts between 8am to 8pm EST on weekdays with an occasional need for scheduled overtime on weekends and holidays as determined by business need.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Understand the business processes and practices within a long-term care or medical facility.
  • Formalized approach to problem-solving, certification in RCA an asset .
  • Excellent communication skills, written and oral with acumen for conveying complex concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Energized and motivated by a fast paced, dynamic, high demand working environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage customer expectations.
  • Ability to quickly learn more complicated aspects of new software functionality, emerging products, and systems that support them.
  • A patient and active listener who is detail-oriented.
  • High level of customer focus and empathy.
  • Prior experience using the PointClickCare application is required.

Required Experience

  • Experience using/supporting PointClickCare
  • 1-2 years practical experience supporting and trouble-shooting web-based software applications
  • Experience using diagnostic tools to help resolve customer issues
  • Experience in Care Delivery, Care Coordination, Business Intelligence, or Financial Performance for either Skilled Nursing, Senior Living, Home Health, or Acute Care facilities
  • Bachelors Degree or post-secondary schooling is preferred
